import pandas as pd, numpy as np, scipy.stats as stats, time
T=time.time()
# Load common-gene matrices, aligned by stable cell-line ID
ch=pd.read_csv('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', nrows=0)
eh=pd.read_csv('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', nrows=0)
first_c=ch.columns[0]; first_e=eh.columns[0]
common=[c for c in ch.columns[1:] if c in eh.columns[1:]]
dt={c:np.float32 for c in common}
cd=pd.read_csv('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', usecols=[first_c]+common, index_col=0, dtype=dt, low_memory=False)
ed=pd.read_csv('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', usecols=[first_e]+common, index_col=0, dtype=dt, low_memory=False)
common_ids=sorted(set(cd.index)&set(ed.index))
cd=cd.loc[common_ids]; ed=ed.loc[common_ids]
print('aligned',cd.shape,'genes',len(common),'load',time.time()-T, flush=True)
# Spearman: rank each gene's observations across cell lines, average ties
r_eff=cd.rank(axis=0, method='average', na_option='keep').to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
r_expr=ed.rank(axis=0, method='average', na_option='keep').to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
print('ranked',time.time()-T, flush=True)
valid=~(np.isnan(r_eff) | np.isnan(r_expr))
n=valid.sum(axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
# pairwise-valid centered Pearson on ranks
def masked_col(x): return np.where(valid, x, 0.0)
sx=masked_col(r_eff).sum(axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
sy=masked_col(r_expr).sum(axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
sxx=masked_col(r_eff*r_eff).sum(axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
syy=masked_col(r_expr*r_expr).sum(axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
sxy=masked_col(r_eff*r_expr).sum(axis=0, dtype=np.float64)
mx=sx/n; my=sy/n
cov=sxy-n*mx*my
varx=sxx-n*mx*mx
vary=syy-n*my*my
denom=np.sqrt(np.maximum(varx*vary, 0))
with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
    rho=cov/denom
rho=np.clip(rho,-1,1)
df=n-2
# scipy spearmanr t approximation
with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
    t=np.sqrt(np.maximum(df,0))*rho/np.sqrt(np.maximum(1-rho*rho, np.finfo(float).tiny))
p=2*stats.t.sf(np.abs(t), df)
finite=np.isfinite(p) & np.isfinite(rho) & (n>=3) & (denom>0)
print('computable genes',int(finite.sum()),'nonfinite p',int((~finite).sum()),'time',time.time()-T, flush=True)
print('n min median max',n.min(),np.median(n),n.max())
print('rho finite range',np.nanmin(rho[finite]),np.nanmax(rho[finite]))
print('p range min max',p[finite].min(),p[finite].max())
# BH on valid p only
pvals=p[finite].copy()
m=pvals.size
order=np.argsort(pvals, kind='mergesort')
rank=np.empty(m, dtype=float)
rank[order]=np.arange(1,m+1)
q=np.empty(m, dtype=float)
q[order]=pvals[order]*m/rank[order]
# enforce monotonic increasing from most significant
for i in range(m-2,-1,-1):
    if q[order[i]] > q[order[i+1]]:
        q[order[i]] = q[order[i+1]]
q=np.minimum(q,1.0)
sig=q<0.05
print('sig BH q<0.05',int(sig.sum()),'percent',float(sig.sum())/m*100)
print('sig unadjusted p<0.05',int((pvals<0.05).sum()),'percent',float((pvals<0.05).sum())/m*100)
# directional counts for sanity; raw effect coordinate signs are for raw gene effect (negative-going)
pos=np.isfinite(rho) & (p<0.05) & (rho>0)
neg=np.isfinite(rho) & (p<0.05) & (rho<0)
print('unadj raw positive significant',int(pos.sum()),'negative',int(neg.sum()))
# BH directional using q mapping
qs_all=np.full(len(common), np.nan)
qs_all[finite]=q
bhsig=qs_all<0.05
raw_rho=rho
print('BH raw-positive',int(((raw_rho>0)&bhsig).sum()),'raw-negative',int(((raw_rho<0)&bhsig).sum()))
print('total common genes',len(common),'time total',time.time()-T)

parameters.content:
"""
Spearman rank correlation between gene expression and CRISPR gene effect (essentiality),
with Benjamini-Hochberg multiple testing correction.

Inputs:
- CRISPRGeneEffect.csv: cell lines x genes, gene effect scores (negative = essential)
- OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv: cell lines x genes, log(TPM+1)
"""

import csv
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import sys

print("=== Step 1: Loading headers and identifying common genes ===", flush=True)

# Read CRISPR header
with open('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', 'r') as f:
    crispr_header = next(csv.reader(f))
# First element is empty string (leading comma = unnamed cell ID column)
crispr_genes_raw = crispr_header[1:]
print(f"CRISPR genes: {len(crispr_genes_raw)}", flush=True)

# Read expression header
with open('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', 'r') as f:
    expr_header = next(csv.reader(f))
expr_genes_raw = expr_header[1:]
print(f"Expression genes: {len(expr_genes_raw)}", flush=True)

# Find common genes
crispr_gene_set = set(crispr_genes_raw)
expr_gene_set = set(expr_genes_raw)
common_genes = sorted(crispr_gene_set & expr_gene_set)
print(f"Common genes: {len(common_genes)}", flush=True)

# Build gene -> column index maps (1-indexed because col 0 is cell ID)
crispr_gene_to_col = {g: i + 1 for i, g in enumerate(crispr_genes_raw) if g in common_genes}
expr_gene_to_col = {g: i + 1 for i, g in enumerate(expr_genes_raw) if g in common_genes}

print("=== Step 2: Identifying common cell lines ===", flush=True)

# Read CRISPR cell IDs
crispr_cell_ids = []
with open('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    next(reader)  # skip header
    for row in reader:
        if row and row[0]:
            crispr_cell_ids.append(row[0])
print(f"CRISPR cell lines: {len(crispr_cell_ids)}", flush=True)

# Read expression cell IDs
expr_cell_ids = []
with open('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    next(reader)
    for row in reader:
        if row and row[0]:
            expr_cell_ids.append(row[0])
print(f"Expression cell lines: {len(expr_cell_ids)}", flush=True)

crispr_cell_set = set(crispr_cell_ids)
expr_cell_set = set(expr_cell_ids)
common_cells = sorted(crispr_cell_set & expr_cell_set)
print(f"Common cell lines: {len(common_cells)}", flush=True)

# Build cell ID -> row index maps
crispr_cell_to_row = {cid: i for i, cid in enumerate(crispr_cell_ids) if cid in common_cells}
expr_cell_to_row = {cid: i for i, cid in enumerate(expr_cell_ids) if cid in common_cells}

print("=== Step 3: Building data matrices ===", flush=True)

n_cells = len(common_cells)
n_genes = len(common_genes)
gene_list = list(common_genes)

# Use float32 to save memory
crispr_data = np.full((n_cells, n_genes), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)
expr_data = np.full((n_cells, n_genes), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)

# Read CRISPR data
print("  Reading CRISPR data...", flush=True)
crispr_rows_read = 0
with open('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    next(reader)  # skip header
    for row in reader:
        if not row or not row[0]:
            continue
        cell_id = row[0]
        if cell_id in crispr_cell_to_row:
            row_idx = crispr_cell_to_row[cell_id]
            for j, gene in enumerate(gene_list):
                col = crispr_gene_to_col[gene]
                if col < len(row) and row[col]:
                    try:
                        crispr_data[row_idx, j] = float(row[col])
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
            crispr_rows_read += 1
            if crispr_rows_read % 200 == 0:
                print(f"    ... {crispr_rows_read} rows processed", flush=True)
print(f"  CRISPR: {crispr_rows_read} common-cell rows read", flush=True)

# Read expression data
print("  Reading expression data...", flush=True)
expr_rows_read = 0
with open('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    next(reader)
    for row in reader:
        if not row or not row[0]:
            continue
        cell_id = row[0]
        if cell_id in expr_cell_to_row:
            row_idx = expr_cell_to_row[cell_id]
            for j, gene in enumerate(gene_list):
                col = expr_gene_to_col[gene]
                if col < len(row) and row[col]:
                    try:
                        expr_data[row_idx, j] = float(row[col])
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
            expr_rows_read += 1
            if expr_rows_read % 200 == 0:
                print(f"    ... {expr_rows_read} rows processed", flush=True)
print(f"  Expression: {expr_rows_read} common-cell rows read", flush=True)

print("=== Step 4: Computing Spearman correlations ===", flush=True)

pvals = np.full(n_genes, np.nan)
rhos = np.full(n_genes, np.nan)
valid_pairs = np.zeros(n_genes, dtype=int)

for j in range(n_genes):
    x = expr_data[:, j].astype(np.float64)
    y = crispr_data[:, j].astype(np.float64)
    mask = ~np.isnan(x) & ~np.isnan(y)
    n = mask.sum()
    valid_pairs[j] = n
    if n < 3:
        pvals[j] = 1.0
        rhos[j] = 0.0
    else:
        # Check for zero variance
        if np.std(x[mask]) == 0 or np.std(y[mask]) == 0:
            pvals[j] = 1.0
            rhos[j] = 0.0
        else:
            rho, p = spearmanr(x[mask], y[mask])
            pvals[j] = p
            rhos[j] = rho

    if (j + 1) % 2000 == 0:
        print(f"  ... {j + 1}/{n_genes} genes processed", flush=True)

print(f"  All {n_genes} genes processed", flush=True)

# Report valid pair counts
print(f"  Valid pair counts: min={valid_pairs.min()}, median={np.median(valid_pairs):.0f}, max={valid_pairs.max()}", flush=True)

print("=== Step 5: Benjamini-Hochberg correction ===", flush=True)

# Some p-values may be NaN (for genes with < 3 valid pairs or zero variance)
# Remove NaN p-values for BH correction
valid = ~np.isnan(pvals)
pvals_valid = pvals[valid]

reject_valid, pvals_corrected_valid, _, _ = multipletests(
    pvals_valid, alpha=0.05, method='fdr_bh'
)

# Map results back
reject = np.zeros(n_genes, dtype=bool)
pvals_corrected = np.ones(n_genes)
pvals_corrected[valid] = pvals_corrected_valid
reject[valid] = reject_valid

n_significant = np.sum(reject)
n_total = n_genes
pct_significant = 100.0 * n_significant / n_total

print(f"  Genes tested: {n_total}", flush=True)
print(f"  Genes with valid p-values: {np.sum(valid)}", flush=True)
print(f"  Significant genes (FDR < 0.05): {n_significant}", flush=True)
print(f"  Percentage: {pct_significant:.6f}%", flush=True)

# Breakdown by direction
sig_pos = np.sum(reject & (rhos > 0))
sig_neg = np.sum(reject & (rhos < 0))
print(f"  Significant positive correlations: {sig_pos}", flush=True)
print(f"  Significant negative correlations: {sig_neg}", flush=True)

# Write answer
import os
os.makedirs('codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{pct_significant:.6f}%\n")

print(f"\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt: {pct_significant:.6f}%", flush=True)

import csv

# Load sample annotations
sample_to_celltype = {}
with open('/tmp/sample_annotated.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        sample_to_celltype[row['sample']] = row['celltype']

# Load expression header
with open('/tmp/expr_header.txt') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip()
    expr_cols = header.split(',')

# Column 1 is gene name (empty header), columns 2-724 are samples
# Map sample name -> column index (1-based)
sample_col_map = {}
for i, col in enumerate(expr_cols):
    if i == 0:
        continue  # skip gene name column
    sample_col_map[col] = i + 1  # 1-based

# Group by cell type
celltype_cols = {'CD4': [], 'CD8': [], 'CD14': [], 'CD19': []}
not_found = []
for sample, ct in sample_to_celltype.items():
    if ct in celltype_cols:
        if sample in sample_col_map:
            celltype_cols[ct].append(sample_col_map[sample])
        else:
            not_found.append(sample)

print("Samples not found in expression columns:", len(not_found))
if not_found:
    for s in not_found[:10]:
        print(f"  {s}")

for ct in ['CD4', 'CD8', 'CD14', 'CD19']:
    cols = sorted(celltype_cols[ct])
    print(f"\n{ct}: {len(cols)} samples")
    print(f"  Column range: {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")
    print(f"  First 5: {cols[:5]}")
    print(f"  Last 5: {cols[-5:]}")
    
    # Generate a compact representation for Galaxy "select columns by indices/slices"
    # The tool accepts Python-like slices, e.g., "1,3,5-10"
    # We need: column 1 (gene name) + these columns
    all_cols = [1] + cols
    print(f"  Total columns to select: {len(all_cols)}")

# Verify: number of expression columns should match number of samples
expr_sample_count = len(expr_cols) - 1  # minus gene name column
anno_sample_count = len(sample_to_celltype)
print(f"\nExpression samples: {expr_sample_count}")
print(f"Annotation samples: {anno_sample_count}")
EOF

ora <- function(fg) {
  sets <- split(ann$ENSEMBL, ann$GOALL); sets <- lapply(sets, unique)

  ok <- hit > 0; sets <- sets[ok]; hit <- hit[ok]
  N <- length(u); n <- length(fg); K <- lengths(sets)

}

}

set -eu

import csv
import math
import sys

iron_in, innate_in = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

def parse_float(value):
    if value is None or value == '' or value.upper() == 'NA':
        return math.nan
    return float(value)

def write_lists(infile, fg_out, bg_out):
    with open(infile, newline='') as handle, \
         open(fg_out, 'w', newline='') as fg, \
         open(bg_out, 'w', newline='') as bg:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter='\t')
        if reader.fieldnames is None:
            raise SystemExit(f'{infile}: no header')
        required = {'rowname', 'log2FoldChange', 'padj'}
        missing = required.difference(reader.fieldnames)
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit(f'{infile}: missing columns {sorted(missing)}')
        fg.write('gene_id\n')
        bg.write('gene_id\n')
        for row in reader:
            gene = row['rowname'].strip()
            if not gene:
                continue
            bg.write(gene + '\n')
            lfc = parse_float(row['log2FoldChange'])
            padj = parse_float(row['padj'])
            if math.isfinite(lfc) and math.isfinite(padj) and abs(lfc) > 1.5 and padj < 0.05:
                fg.write(gene + '\n')

write_lists(iron_in, 'iron_foreground.tsv', 'iron_background.tsv')
write_lists(innate_in, 'innate_foreground.tsv', 'innate_background.tsv')
PY

import csv, math, sys

def kegg_id(gene):
    gene = gene.strip()
    if not gene:
        return ''
    return gene if ':' in gene else 'pau:' + gene

def parse_float(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    v = value.strip()
    if not v or v.upper() == 'NA' or v.lower() == 'nan':
        return None
    try:
        x = float(v)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if math.isnan(x):
        return None
    return x

def write_lists(in_path, fg_path, bg_path, summary_path):
    total = 0
    fg_count = 0
    bg_seen = set()
    fg_seen = set()
    with open(in_path, newline='') as handle:
        reader = csv.DictReader(handle, delimiter='\t')
        needed = {'rowname', 'log2FoldChange', 'padj'}
        missing = needed.difference(reader.fieldnames or [])
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit('Missing columns in %s: %s' % (in_path, ','.join(sorted(missing))))
        for row in reader:
            total += 1
            gid = kegg_id(row.get('rowname', ''))
            if gid:
                bg_seen.add(gid)
            lfc = parse_float(row.get('log2FoldChange'))
            padj = parse_float(row.get('padj'))
            if gid and lfc is not None and padj is not None and abs(lfc) > 1.5 and padj < 0.05:
                fg_seen.add(gid)
    with open(fg_path, 'w') as out:
        for gid in sorted(fg_seen):
            out.write(gid + '\n')
    with open(bg_path, 'w') as out:
        for gid in sorted(bg_seen):
            out.write(gid + '\n')
    with open(summary_path, 'w') as out:
        out.write('input\trows\tbackground_genes\tforeground_genes\n')
        out.write('%s\t%d\t%d\t%d\n' % (in_path, total, len(bg_seen), len(fg_seen)))

write_lists(sys.argv[1], 'glu_fe_fg.txt', 'glu_fe_bg.txt', 'glu_fe_summary.tsv')
write_lists(sys.argv[2], 'succ_fg.txt', 'succ_bg.txt', 'succ_summary.tsv')

ora <- function(res, minGSSize = 1L, maxGSSize = Inf, universe_mode = c("tested_mapped", "kegg_all"), include_zero = FALSE) {
  universe_mode <- match.arg(universe_mode)
  fg0 <- res$gene[!is.na(res$padj) & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1.5 & res$padj < 0.05]

ora_sig <- function(res) {
  foreground <- res$gene[!is.na(res$padj) & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1.5 & res$padj < 0.05]

import subprocess, urllib.request, math, statistics

def read_deseq(path):
    code = r'''
x<-readRDS(commandArgs(TRUE)[1])
ld<-attr(x,\"listData\")
rn<-attr(x,\"rownames\")
cat(\"gene\\tbaseMean\\tlog2FoldChange\\tlfcSE\\tstat\\tpvalue\\tpadj\\n\")

}
'''
    p = subprocess.run(['Rscript','-e',code,path], text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=True)

    for line in lines[1:]:

# hypergeom p-value P[X >= k] using logsumexp. M universe size, n pathway genes in universe, N fg in universe.
def hypergeom_sf(k, M, n, N):
    maxx=min(n,N)
    if k>maxx: return 0.0
    logs=[]
    denom=math.lgamma(M+1)-math.lgamma(N+1)-math.lgamma(M-N+1)
    for x in range(k, maxx+1):
        if N-x <= M-n and x <= n:
            logp=(math.lgamma(n+1)-math.lgamma(x+1)-math.lgamma(n-x+1)
                  + math.lgamma(M-n+1)-math.lgamma(N-x+1)-math.lgamma(M-n-(N-x)+1)
                  - denom)
            logs.append(logp)
    if not logs: return 1.0
    m=max(logs)
    return min(1.0, math.exp(m)*sum(math.exp(z-m) for z in logs))

def bh(pvals):
    m=len(pvals)
    order=sorted(range(m), key=lambda i:pvals[i])
    adj=[None]*m
    prev=1.0
    for rank_idx in range(m-1, -1, -1):
        i=order[rank_idx]
        rank=rank_idx+1
        val=pvals[i]*m/rank
        if val>prev: val=prev
        prev=val
        adj[i]=min(1.0,val)
    return adj

 ok <- lengths(spl)>=10 & lengths(spl)<=500

}

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > ora.py <<'PY'
import csv
import re
import sys

import scipy
from scipy.stats import hypergeom

if tuple(int(x) for x in scipy.__version__.split(".")[:2]) < (1, 0):
    raise RuntimeError("SciPy version is too old")

def bare_id(token):
    token = token.strip()
    if ":" in token:
        return token.rsplit(":", 1)[1]
    return token

def pathway_number(token):
    token = bare_id(token)
    match = re.search(r"(\d{5})$", token)
    if match is None:
        return None
    return match.group(1)

def read_gene_ids(path):
    genes = set()
    header_tokens = {
        "rowname", "gene", "gene_id", "geneid", "id", "locus_tag",
        "geneid/term", "query"
    }
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            token = line.rstrip("\r\n").split("\t", 1)[0].strip()
            if token and token.lower() not in header_tokens:
                genes.add(bare_id(token))
    return genes

def read_mapping(path):
    pathways = {}
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            fields = line.rstrip("\r\n").split("\t")
            if len(fields) < 2:
                continue
            gene = bare_id(fields[0])
            number = pathway_number(fields[1])
            if gene and number:
                pathways.setdefault(number, set()).add(gene)
    if not pathways:
        raise RuntimeError("The Galaxy KEGG mapping input had no pathway rows")
    return pathways

def benjamini_hochberg(pvalues):
    count = len(pvalues)
    adjusted = [1.0] * count
    order = sorted(range(count), key=lambda index: pvalues[index])
    running = 1.0
    for rank in range(count, 0, -1):
        index = order[rank - 1]
        running = min(running, pvalues[index] * count / float(rank))
        adjusted[index] = min(1.0, running)
    return adjusted

def ora(foreground, background, pathways):
    universe = set()
    for genes in pathways.values():
        universe.update(genes.intersection(background))
    mapped_foreground = foreground.intersection(universe)
    tested = []
    pvalues = []
    hits = {}
    for number in sorted(pathways):
        pathway_genes = pathways[number]
        overlap = len(mapped_foreground.intersection(pathway_genes))
        if overlap == 0:
            continue
        pathway_universe = len(universe.intersection(pathway_genes))
        if pathway_universe == 0:
            continue
        hits[number] = overlap
        pvalues.append(float(hypergeom.sf(
            overlap - 1, len(universe), pathway_universe, len(mapped_foreground)
        )))
        tested.append(number)
    return {
        "universe_size": len(universe),
        "foreground_size": len(mapped_foreground),
        "padj": dict(zip(tested, benjamini_hochberg(pvalues))),
        "hits": hits,
    }

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 6:
        raise RuntimeError("Expected four gene-list paths and one KEGG mapping path")
    iron_foreground = read_gene_ids(sys.argv[1])
    iron_background = read_gene_ids(sys.argv[2])
    innate_foreground = read_gene_ids(sys.argv[3])
    innate_background = read_gene_ids(sys.argv[4])
    pathways = read_mapping(sys.argv[5])
    iron = ora(iron_foreground, iron_background, pathways)
    innate = ora(innate_foreground, innate_background, pathways)

    pathway_numbers = sorted(set(iron["padj"]).union(innate["padj"]))
    answer_count = 0
    with open("result.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as output:
        writer = csv.writer(output, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writerow([
            "pathway_id", "pathway_name", "iron_depleted_padj",
            "innate_media_padj", "iron_depleted_significant",
            "innate_media_significant", "iron_depleted_hits",
            "innate_media_hits", "kegg_organism_code",
            "iron_universe_mapped", "innate_universe_mapped"
        ])
        for number in pathway_numbers:
            iron_padj = iron["padj"].get(number, 1.0)
            innate_padj = innate["padj"].get(number, 1.0)
            iron_sig = iron_padj < 0.05
            innate_sig = innate_padj < 0.05
            if iron_sig and not innate_sig:
                answer_count += 1
            writer.writerow([
                "map" + number,
                "KEGG pathway " + number,
                "%.17g" % iron_padj,
                "%.17g" % innate_padj,
                "1" if iron_sig else "0",
                "1" if innate_sig else "0",
                str(iron["hits"].get(number, 0)),
                str(innate["hits"].get(number, 0)),
                "pau",
                str(iron["universe_size"]),
                str(innate["universe_size"])
            ])
    with open("answer.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as answer:
        answer.write(str(answer_count) + "\n")

main()
PY

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
options(timeout=120)
read_kegg <- function(u) {
  con <- url(u, open='rb'); on.exit(close(con), add=TRUE)
  z <- readLines(con, warn=FALSE)
  z <- z[nzchar(z)]
  do.call(rbind, strsplit(z, '\\\\t', fixed=FALSE))
}
links <- read_kegg('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau')
pathway_names <- read_kegg('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau')
pathway_genes <- split(sub('"'^pau:'"', '', links[,1]), sub('"'^path:'"', '', links[,2]))
pathway_genes <- lapply(pathway_genes, unique)
universe <- unique(unlist(pathway_genes))
pathway_names <- setNames(pathway_names[,2], pathway_names[,1])

enrich <- function(file) {
  obj <- readRDS(file)
  at <- attributes(obj)
  tab <- at"'$listData
  ids <- at$rownames
  keep <- is.finite(tab$log2FoldChange) & is.finite(tab$padj) &
          abs(tab$log2FoldChange) > 1.5 & tab$padj < 0.05
  query <- intersect(ids[keep], universe)
  sets <- lapply(pathway_genes, intersect, universe)
  sizes <- lengths(sets)
  overlaps <- vapply(sets, function(s) sum(s %in% query), integer(1))
  tested <- overlaps > 0 & sizes >= 10 & sizes <= 500
  p <- phyper(overlaps[tested] - 1, sizes[tested],
              length(universe) - sizes[tested], length(query), lower.tail=FALSE)
  padj <- p.adjust(p, method='"'BH')
  sig <- names(sets)[tested][padj < 0.05]
  list(ids=ids, nfilter=sum(keep), nquery=length(query), sig=sig,
       result=data.frame(id=names(sets)[tested], size=sizes[tested],
                         overlap=overlaps[tested], p=p, padj=padj,
                         row.names=NULL))
}
iron <- enrich('/workspace/inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds')
innate <- enrich('/workspace/inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds')
cat('iron-filtered=', iron"'$nfilter, '"'iron-KEGG=', iron"'$nquery, '"'\\n', sep='')
cat('innate-filtered=', innate"'$nfilter, '"'innate-KEGG=', innate"'$nquery, '"'\\n', sep='')
cat('iron significant:\\n')
print(data.frame(id=iron"'$sig, description=unname(pathway_names[iron$sig])))
cat('"'innate significant:\\n')
print(data.frame(id=innate"'$sig, description=unname(pathway_names[innate$sig])))
diff <- setdiff(iron$sig, innate$sig)
cat('"'difference:', paste(diff, collapse=','), 'count=', length(diff), '\\n', sep='')
RS"

read_res <- function(f) {
  a <- attributes(readRDS(f))
  z <- as.data.frame(a"'$listData, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  rownames(z) <- a$rownames
  z
}
res <- lapply(c('"'inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds','inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds'), read_res)
names(res) <- c('GluFevsGluFePlus','SuccvsGluFePlus')
m <- read.delim(url('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau'), header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, col.names=c('gene','path'))
m"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^[''^:]+:'"', '', m"'$gene)
m$path <- sub('"'"'^[''^:]+:'"', '', m"'$path)
terms <- split(m$gene, m$path)
terms <- lapply(terms, unique)
run_ora <- function(z, universe_mode='"'kegg', minGS=10, maxGS=500) {
  fg <- rownames(z)[is.finite(z"'$log2FoldChange) & is.finite(z$padj) & abs(z$log2FoldChange)>1.5 & z$padj<0.05]
  extID <- unique(unlist(terms))
  if (universe_mode == '"'tested') extID <- intersect(extID, rownames(z))
  q <- intersect(unique(fg), extID)
  qmap <- lapply(q, function(g) names(terms)[vapply(terms, function(s) g %in% s, logical(1))])
  names(qmap) <- q
  qdf <- data.frame(extID=rep(names(qmap), times=lengths(qmap)), termID=unlist(qmap), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  qdf <- unique(qdf)
  qterm2gene <- split(qdf"'$extID, qdf$termID)
  qterm2gene <- lapply(qterm2gene, unique)
  term2gene <- lapply(terms, intersect, extID)
  # terms hit by query only, then size filter as in DOSE
  tested <- intersect(names(qterm2gene), names(term2gene))
  term_sizes <- vapply(term2gene[tested], length, integer(1))
  keep <- term_sizes >= minGS & term_sizes <= maxGS
  tested <- tested[keep]
  if (!length(tested)) return(data.frame())
  k <- vapply(qterm2gene[tested], length, integer(1))
  M <- vapply(term2gene[tested], length, integer(1))
  n <- length(q)
  N <- length(extID)
  p <- phyper(k-1, M, N-M, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
  padj <- p.adjust(p, method='"'BH')
  out <- data.frame(path=tested, k=k, M=M, n=n, N=N, p=p, padj=padj, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  out[order(out"'$p),]
}
for (mode in c('"'kegg','tested')) {
  cat('\\nMODE',mode,'\\n')
  oo <- lapply(res, run_ora, universe_mode=mode)
  for (nm in names(oo)) {
    o <- oo[[nm]]
    cat(nm, 'tested=', nrow(o), 'sig=', sum(o"'$padj<0.05), '"'\\n')
    if (sum(o"'$padj<0.05)) print(o[o$padj<0.05, c('"'path','k','M','n','N','p','padj')], row.names=FALSE)
  }
  a <- oo[[1]]"'$path[oo[[1]]$padj<0.05]
  b <- oo[[2]]$path[oo[[2]]$padj<0.05]
  cat('"'GluFe-only vs Succ=', length(setdiff(a,b)), '\\n')
  cat('Succ-only vs GluFe=', length(setdiff(b,a)), '\\n')
  cat('intersection=', length(intersect(a,b)), '\\n')
}
RS"

m"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^[''^:]+:'"', '', m"'$gene); m$path <- sub('"'"'^[''^:]+:'"', '', m"'$path)
sets <- lapply(split(m$gene, m$path), unique)
names_by_path <- read.delim(url('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau'), header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, col.names=c('path','name'))
names_by_path"'$path <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', names_by_path"'$path)
name_map <- setNames(sub('"' - Pseudomonas aeruginosa UCBPP-PA14"'$'"', '', names_by_path"'$name), names_by_path$path)
ora <- function(z, min_size=10L, max_size=500L) {
  fg <- rownames(z)[is.finite(z$log2FoldChange) & is.finite(z$padj) & abs(z$log2FoldChange)>1.5 & z$padj<0.05]
  bg <- intersect(unique(unlist(sets)), rownames(z))
  q <- intersect(unique(fg), bg)
  qhits <- vapply(sets, function(s) sum(q %in% s), integer(1))
  sizes <- vapply(sets, function(s) sum(intersect(s,bg) %in% bg), integer(1))
  tested <- qhits > 0L & sizes >= min_size & sizes <= max_size
  p <- phyper(qhits[tested]-1L, sizes[tested], length(bg)-sizes[tested], length(q), lower.tail=FALSE)
  adj <- p.adjust(p, '"'BH')
  data.frame(path=names(sets)[tested], hits=qhits[tested], size=sizes[tested], p=p, padj=adj, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
out <- lapply(files, function(f) ora(read_res(f))); sig <- lapply(out, function(x) x"'$path[x$padj < .05])
cat('"'Foreground and mapped counts:\\n')
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  z <- read_res(files[[i]]); fg <- rownames(z)[abs(z"'$log2FoldChange)>1.5 & z$padj<.05]
  cat(names(files)[i], length(fg), '"'foreground;', length(intersect(fg, unique(unlist(sets)))), 'mapped; ', length(sig[[i]]), 'significant\\n', sep=' ')
}
cat('Iron significant:\\n'); print(data.frame(path=sig"'$iron, description=unname(name_map[sig$iron]), padj=out$iron$padj[match(sig$iron,out$iron$path)]), row.names=FALSE)
cat('"'Innate significant:\\n'); print(data.frame(path=sig"'$innate, description=unname(name_map[sig$innate]), padj=out$innate$padj[match(sig$innate,out$innate$path)]), row.names=FALSE)
cat('"'Iron-only:', paste(setdiff(sig"'$iron,sig$innate), collapse='"','), ' count=', length(setdiff(sig"'$iron,sig$innate)), '"'\\n', sep='')
# Check sensitivity to standard size filter vs no size filter.
for (ms in c(1L, 5L, 10L)) {
  oo <- lapply(files, function(f) ora(read_res(f), min_size=ms, max_size=Inf))

}

sets_all <- split(link$gene, link$pathway); sets_all <- lapply(sets_all, unique)
files <- list(GluFevsGluFePlus='"'/workspace/inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds', SuccvsGluFePlus='/workspace/inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds')
res <- list()
for (nm in names(files)) {
 x<-readRDS(files[[nm]]); genes<-attr(x,'rownames',exact=TRUE); d<-x@listData
 sig<-genes[abs(d"'$log2FoldChange)>1.5 & d$padj<0.05]
 res[[nm]] <- list(all=genes,sig=sig)
}
ora <- function(sig, universe_mode=c('"'kegg','tested','tested_mapped'), sizes=TRUE) {
 universe_all <- res[[1]]"'$all # same 5828
 if (universe_mode=='"'kegg') { U <- unique(link"'$gene) } else if (universe_mode=='"'tested') { U <- universe_all } else { U <- intersect(universe_all, unique(link"'$gene)) }
 S <- intersect(sig,U)
 sets <- lapply(sets_all, intersect, y=U)
 keep <- vapply(sets,length,integer(1)) >= if(sizes) 10 else 1L & vapply(sets,length,integer(1)) <= if(sizes) 500 else Inf
 # precedence risk; explicit
 sz <- vapply(sets,length,integer(1)); keep <- if(sizes) sz>=10 & sz<=500 else sz>=1
 sets <- sets[keep]
 vals <- lapply(sets, function(g) {
  k <- sum(S %in% g); M <- length(g); N <- length(U); n <- length(S)
  c(k=k,M=M,N=N,n=n,p=if(k>0) phyper(k-1,M,N-M,n,lower.tail=FALSE) else 1)
 })
 tab <- do.call(rbind, vals); tab <- as.data.frame(tab); tab$padj <- p.adjust(tab$p,'"'BH'); tab"'$pathway <- rownames(tab); rownames(tab)<-NULL
 tab$name <- path$name[match(tab$pathway,path$pathway)]
 tab <- tab[order(tab$padj,tab$p),c('"'pathway','name','k','M','N','n','p','padj')]
 tab
}
for (mode in c('kegg','tested','tested_mapped')) {
 cat('\\n### mode',mode,'###\\n')
 tabs <- lapply(res, function(z) ora(z"'$sig,mode))
 for (nm in names(tabs)) {
  t<-tabs[[nm]]; cat(nm,'"'sig',sum(t"'$padj<0.05),'"'of',nrow(t),'mapped genes',t"'$n[1], '"'\\n')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests, math, time, os
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

def read_csv(path):
    df=pd.read_csv(path)
    df['padj']=pd.to_numeric(df['padj'], errors='coerce')
    df['log2FoldChange']=pd.to_numeric(df['log2FoldChange'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def fetch_kegg(species='pau', cache_dir='/tmp'):
    cache_link=os.path.join(cache_dir, f'kegg_link_pathway_{species}.txt')
    cache_list=os.path.join(cache_dir, f'kegg_list_pathway_{species}.txt')
    if not os.path.exists(cache_link):
        r=requests.get(f'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/{species}', timeout=120)
        r.raise_for_status()
        open(cache_link,'w').write(r.text)
    if not os.path.exists(cache_list):
        r=requests.get(f'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/{species}', timeout=120)
        r.raise_for_status()
        open(cache_list,'w').write(r.text)
    link=open(cache_link).read().splitlines()
    names=open(cache_list).read().splitlines()
    return link, names

def parse_mapping(link, names):
    # clusterProfiler strips everything before colon for both
    rows=[]
    for line in link:
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split('\\t')
        if len(parts)<2: continue
        # KEGGREST keggLink returns gene in first? Our endpoint link/pathway/pau gives gene -> path
        g=parts[0].split(':',1)[-1]
        p=parts[1].split(':',1)[-1]
        rows.append((p,g))
    path2gene=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['path','gene']).dropna().drop_duplicates()
    path2name={}
    for line in names:
        if not line.strip(): continue
        parts=line.split('\\t')
        if len(parts)<2: continue
        pid=parts[0]
        # clusterProfiler name strip; not needed
        nm=parts[1]
        path2name[pid]=nm
    # filter to named terms
    path2gene=path2gene[path2gene['path'].isin(path2name.keys())].copy()
    return path2gene, path2name

def r_bh(p):
    p=np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
    n=len(p)
    if n==0: return np.array([])
    i=np.arange(n,0,-1)
    o=np.argsort(p, kind='stable')[::-1] # decreasing p? Wait R o <- order(p, decreasing=TRUE)
    ro=np.argsort(o, kind='stable')
    adj=pmin_one(np.minimum.accumulate((n/i)*p[o]))[ro]
    return adj

def pmin_one(x):
    return np.minimum(1.0, x)

def ora(genes, path2gene):
    # genes iterable; unique, strings
    genes=[str(g) for g in genes]
    genes=list(dict.fromkeys(genes))
    # gene -> path mapping from annotation (all)
    g2p=path2gene.groupby('gene')['path'].apply(list).to_dict()
    # qExtID2TermID only for input genes mapped
    qmap={g:g2p[g] for g in genes if g in g2p}
    if not qmap: return None, {}
    # qExtID2TermID.df & split
    rows=[]
    for g,ps in qmap.items():
        for p in ps:
            rows.append((p,g))
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['path','gene']).drop_duplicates()
    qterm2ext={p:list(grp['gene']) for p,grp in df.groupby('path')}
    # extID universe = all unique genes in path2gene
    extID=list(dict.fromkeys(path2gene['gene']))
    # no universe -> as is
    qterm2ext={p:[g for g in gs if g in extID] for p,gs in qterm2ext.items()}
    qterms=list(qterm2ext.keys())
    term2ext={p:[g for g in path2gene.loc[path2gene.path==p,'gene'] if g in extID] for p in qterms}
    # filter size
    idx={p for p in qterms if 10 <= len(term2ext[p]) <= 500}
    qterms=[p for p in qterms if p in idx]
    qterm2ext={p:qterm2ext[p] for p in qterms}
    term2ext={p:term2ext[p] for p in qterms}
    qterms=list(dict.fromkeys(qterm2ext.keys()))
    if not qterms: return None, {}
    k=np.array([len(qterm2ext[p]) for p in qterms], dtype=int)
    M=np.array([len(term2ext[p]) for p in qterms], dtype=int)
    N=len(extID)
    n=len(qmap)
    # p-values
    pvals=[]
    for kk,mm in zip(k,M):
        # phyper(kk-1, mm, N-mm, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
        p=hypergeom.sf(kk-1, N, mm, n)
        pvals.append(p)
    pvals=np.array(pvals)
    adj=r_bh(pvals)
    res=pd.DataFrame({
        'ID':qterms,
        'Count':k,
        'Size':M,
        'pvalue':pvals,
        'p.adjust':adj,
        'geneID':['/'.join(qterm2ext[p]) for p in qterms],
    })
    return res, path2name

def enriched_pathways(res):
    return set(res.loc[res['p.adjust']<0.05,'ID'])

import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
import numpy as np, math

def bh(p):
    p=np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
    n=len(p)
    if n==0: return p
    order=np.argsort(p, kind='mergesort')
    rank=np.empty(n, dtype=float)
    rank[order]=np.arange(1,n+1)
    adj=p*n/rank
    # enforce monotonicity as in R p.adjust
    out=adj.copy()
    for i in range(n-2,-1,-1):
        o=order[i]
        if out[order[i+1]] < out[o]:
            out[o]=out[order[i+1]]
    return out

# KEGG links
links=[]
for line in open('tmp/pau_pathway_links.txt'):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    a,b=line.split('\\t')
    gene=a.split(':')[-1]
    path=b.split(':')[-1]
    links.append((path,gene))
links_df=pd.DataFrame(links, columns=['path','gene'])

# list pathways, description
path_names={}
for line in open('tmp/pau_pathway_list.txt'):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    pid,name=line.split('\\t',1)
    path_names[pid]=name

links_df=links_df[links_df['path'].isin(path_names)].drop_duplicates()

path2genes={p: set(g['gene']) for p,g in links_df.groupby('path')}
gene2paths={g: set(r['path']) for g,r in links_df.groupby('gene')}
allext=sorted(set(links_df['gene']))
print('links',len(links_df),'genes',len(allext),'pathways',len(path2genes))

def run(fname):
    d=pd.read_csv(fname)
    d=d[(d.log2FoldChange.abs()>1.5) & (d.padj<0.05)]
    genes=sorted(set(d.gene.dropna()))
    qext2term={g: gene2paths.get(g,set()) for g in genes}
    qext2term={g:ts for g,ts in qext2term.items() if ts}
    n_map=len(qext2term)
    # qTermID2ExtID with foreground only
    qterm2ext={}
    for g,ts in qext2term.items():
        for t in ts:
            qterm2ext.setdefault(t,set()).add(g)
    term2ext={p: path2genes[p] for p in qterm2ext}
    # filter by full set size after intersect allext (already)
    kept=[p for p in term2ext if 10 <= len(term2ext[p]) <= 500]
    qterm2ext={p:qterm2ext[p] for p in kept}
    term2ext={p:term2ext[p] for p in kept}
    terms=sorted(qterm2ext)
    N=len(allext)
    rows=[]
    for p in terms:
        k=len(qterm2ext[p])
        M=len(term2ext[p])
        n=n_map
        pv=hypergeom.sf(k-1, N, M, n)
        rows.append((p,k,M,pv))
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['ID','Count','Size','pvalue'])
    df['p.adjust']=bh(df.pvalue.values)
    df['qvalue']=df['p.adjust']
    sig=df[df['p.adjust']<0.05].sort_values('p.adjust').copy()
    sig['Description']=sig.ID.map(path_names)
    print('\\n',fname,'DEGs',len(genes),'mapped foreground',n_map,'tested',len(df),'sig padj',len(sig))
    print(sig[['ID','Description','Count','Size','pvalue','p.adjust']].to_string(index=False))
    return set(sig.ID)

a=run('tmp/GluFevsGluFePlus.csv')
b=run('tmp/SuccvsGluFePlus.csv')
inter=a&b
only=a-b
print('\\nintersection',len(inter),'iron-only',len(only))
print('iron-only IDs:', sorted(only))
print('intersection IDs:', sorted(inter))
print('\\nANSWER',len(only))
PY
python3 tmp/kegg_ora.py"

calls.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cd /workspace && Rscript - <<'RS'
library(jsonlite)
D <- fromJSON('tmp/kegg_pau.json')
g2p <- D"'$g2p
p2g <- split(rep(names(g2p), lengths(g2p)), unlist(g2p))
all_annotated <- unique(names(g2p))
ora <- function(degs, universe=NULL, minsize=1, maxsize=Inf) {
  genes <- unique(degs)
  mapped <- genes[genes %in% names(g2p)]
  qpaths <- unique(unlist(g2p[mapped], use.names=FALSE))
  extID <- if (is.null(universe)) all_annotated else intersect(universe, all_annotated)
  res <- list()
  for (p in sort(qpaths)) {
    pathway_genes <- intersect(p2g[[p]], extID)
    M <- length(pathway_genes)
    if (M < minsize || M > maxsize) next
    k <- length(intersect(mapped, pathway_genes))
    if (k == 0) next
    N <- length(extID); n <- length(mapped)
    pv <- phyper(k - 1, M, N - M, n, lower.tail = FALSE)
    res[[p]] <- c(k=k, M=M, pvalue=pv)
  }
  if (length(res)==0) return(NULL)
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res), function(p) data.frame(ID=p,k=res[[p]]['"'k'],M=res[[p]]['M'],pvalue=res[[p]]['pvalue'],stringsAsFactors=FALSE)))
  df"'$padj <- p.adjust(df$pvalue, '"'BH')
  df[order(df"'$pvalue),]
}
gl <- readLines('"'tmp/GluFe_degs.txt'); sl <- readLines('tmp/Succ_degs.txt')
for (mode in c('no_size_filter','min1max500','min0max500')) {
  if(mode=='no_size_filter'){mn<-1; mx<-Inf}
  else if(mode=='min1max500'){mn<-1;mx<-500}
  else {mn<-0;mx<-500}
  g<-ora(gl,NULL,mn,mx); s<-ora(sl,NULL,mn,mx)
  cat('\\n',mode,'\\n')
  cat('GluFe tested',nrow(g),'sig',sum(g"'$padj<.05),paste(g$ID[g$padj<.05],collapse='"','),'\\n')
  cat('Succ tested',nrow(s),'sig',sum(s"'$padj<.05),paste(s$ID[s$padj<.05],collapse='"','),'\\n')
  cat('only',length(setdiff(g"'$ID[g$padj<.05],s$ID[s$padj<.05])),paste(setdiff(g$ID[g$padj<.05],s$ID[s$padj<.05]),collapse='"','),'\\n')
}
RS"

    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "deseq2-filter-significant-genes-v1",
    "name": "Filter significant DESeq2 genes",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/pandas:2.2.1",
    "shell_command": (
        "python << 'PYEOF'\n"
        "import sys\n"
        "import pandas as pd\n"
        "\n"
        "df = pd.read_csv('${input}', sep='\\t')\n"
        "mask = (df['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 1.5) & (df['padj'] < 0.05)\n"
        "result = df.loc[mask, ['rowname']]\n"
        "result.to_csv('result.tsv', sep='\\t', index=False, header=False)\n"
        "print(f'Input genes: {len(df)}, Significant: {len(result)}', file=sys.stderr)\n"
        "PYEOF"
    ),
    "inputs": [
        {
            "name": "input",
            "type": "data",

            "type": "data",
            "format": "tabular",
            "from_work_dir": "result.tsv"

import bioblend.galaxy
api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

# Download both full KEGG ORA results
iron_id = "f9cad7b01a4721354053f8b015161385"
innate_id = "f9cad7b01a472135d057e3194e04b098"

iron_content = gi.datasets.download_dataset(iron_id, maxwait=60).decode('utf-8')
innate_content = gi.datasets.download_dataset(innate_id, maxwait=60).decode('utf-8')

# Parse tab-separated results
def parse_ora(content, label):
    lines = content.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0].split('\t')
    print(f"\n=== {label} ===")
    print(f"Header: {header}")
    print(f"Total lines: {len(lines)}")
    
    pathways = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        cols = line.split('\t')
        pathway_id = cols[0]
        pathway_name = cols[1]
        adj_p = float(cols[7])
        pathways[pathway_id] = {
            'name': pathway_name,
            'adj_p': adj_p,
            'hits': int(cols[2]),
            'pathway_genes': int(cols[3]),
            'fg_in_universe': int(cols[4]),
            'universe': int(cols[5]),
            'p_value': float(cols[6])
        }
    return pathways

iron_pathways = parse_ora(iron_content, "Iron-depleted (GluFe vs GluFe+)")
innate_pathways = parse_ora(innate_content, "Innate media (Succ vs GluFe+)")

# Find pathways significant in iron-depleted (adj_p < 0.05) but NOT in innate media (adj_p >= 0.05)
print("\n=== Analysis ===")
iron_sig = {pid: pw for pid, pw in iron_pathways.items() if pw['adj_p'] < 0.05}
innate_sig = {pid: pw for pid, pw in innate_pathways.items() if pw['adj_p'] < 0.05}

print(f"Iron-depleted significant pathways (adj_p < 0.05): {len(iron_sig)}")
for pid, pw in sorted(iron_sig.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]['adj_p']):
    print(f"  {pid}: {pw['name']} (adj_p={pw['adj_p']:.2e})")

print(f"\nInnate media significant pathways (adj_p < 0.05): {len(innate_sig)}")
for pid, pw in sorted(innate_sig.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]['adj_p']):
    print(f"  {pid}: {pw['name']} (adj_p={pw['adj_p']:.2e})")

# Iron-depleted significant but NOT innate media significant
iron_only = {pid: pw for pid, pw in iron_sig.items() if pid not in innate_sig or innate_pathways[pid]['adj_p'] >= 0.05}
print(f"\nIron-depleted ONLY significant (not significant in innate media): {len(iron_only)}")
for pid, pw in sorted(iron_only.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]['adj_p']):
    innate_adj = innate_pathways.get(pid, {}).get('adj_p', float('inf'))
    print(f"  {pid}: {pw['name']}")
    print(f"    Iron-depleted adj_p: {pw['adj_p']:.2e}")
    if pid in innate_pathways:
        print(f"    Innate media adj_p: {innate_adj:.2e}")

# Write answer
answer = len(iron_only)
with open("/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(str(answer))
print(f"\nAnswer: {answer}")

# Also verify: pathways significant in BOTH
both_sig = {pid for pid in iron_sig if pid in innate_sig}
print(f"\nPathways significant in BOTH: {len(both_sig)}")
for pid in sorted(both_sig):
    print(f"  {pid}: {iron_pathways[pid]['name']}")

# Iron-depleted (GluFe) significant pathways (adj_p < 0.05)
glufe_sig = set()
with open('/workspace/glufe_kegg_ora.tsv') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split('\t')
    adj_p_idx = header.index('adjusted_p_value')
    pid_idx = header.index('pathway_id')
    for line in f:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        adj_p = float(cols[adj_p_idx])
        if adj_p < 0.05:
            glufe_sig.add(cols[pid_idx])

# Innate media (Succ) significant pathways (adj_p < 0.05)
succ_sig = set()
with open('/workspace/succ_kegg_ora.tsv') as f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split('\t')
    adj_p_idx = header.index('adjusted_p_value')
    pid_idx = header.index('pathway_id')
    for line in f:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        adj_p = float(cols[adj_p_idx])
        if adj_p < 0.05:
            succ_sig.add(cols[pid_idx])

print(f'Iron-depleted significant pathways ({len(glufe_sig)}):')
for p in sorted(glufe_sig):
    print(f'  {p}')

print(f'\nInnate media significant pathways ({len(succ_sig)}):')
for p in sorted(succ_sig):
    print(f'  {p}')

iron_only = glufe_sig - succ_sig
print(f'\nIron-depleted ONLY (not significant in innate media): {len(iron_only)}')
for p in sorted(iron_only):
    print(f'  {p}')
"

python3 << 'EOF'
import bioblend.galaxy
api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

# Download GluFe (iron-depleted) table
content = gi.datasets.download_dataset("f9cad7b01a47213510f133f4f6c81b1f")
text = content.decode() if isinstance(content, bytes) else content
lines = text.strip().split('\n')
header = lines[0].split('\t')
print("GluFe header:", header)

# Parse and filter
glufe_genes = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) < 7:
        continue
    gene = parts[0]
    try:
        log2fc = float(parts[2])
        padj = float(parts[6])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        continue
    if abs(log2fc) > 1.5 and padj < 0.05:
        glufe_genes.append(gene)

print(f"GluFe (iron-depleted) DEGs: {len(glufe_genes)}")

# Download Succ (innate media) table
content2 = gi.datasets.download_dataset("f9cad7b01a472135d7e895f92581a6d4")
text2 = content2.decode() if isinstance(content2, bytes) else content2
lines2 = text2.strip().split('\n')
header2 = lines2[0].split('\t')
print("Succ header:", header2)

succ_genes = []
for line in lines2[1:]:
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) < 7:
        continue
    gene = parts[0]
    try:
        log2fc = float(parts[2])
        padj = float(parts[6])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        continue
    if abs(log2fc) > 1.5 and padj < 0.05:
        succ_genes.append(gene)

print(f"Succ (innate media) DEGs: {len(succ_genes)}")

# Write gene lists
with open('/workspace/glufe_degs.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write("gene_id\n")
    for g in glufe_genes:
        f.write(f"{g}\n")

with open('/workspace/succ_degs.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write("gene_id\n")
    for g in succ_genes:
        f.write(f"{g}\n")

print("Gene lists written to /workspace/glufe_degs.txt and /workspace/succ_degs.txt")

# Also prepare combined background (all genes from both files)
all_genes = set()
for line in lines[1:]:
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 1 and parts[0]:
        all_genes.add(parts[0])
for line in lines2[1:]:
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 1 and parts[0]:
        all_genes.add(parts[0])

print(f"Total unique genes (background): {len(all_genes)}")

with open('/workspace/background_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write("gene_id\n")
    for g in sorted(all_genes):
        f.write(f"{g}\n")
EOF

import requests
import time

# Get pathway-gene links for PA14
def fetch_kegg(url, desc="data", retries=3):
    for i in range(retries):
        try:
            r = requests.get(url, timeout=60)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                return r.text
            elif r.status_code == 404:
                return None
            else:
                print(f"  {desc}: status {r.status_code}, retry {i+1}")
                time.sleep(2)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  {desc}: error {e}, retry {i+1}")
            time.sleep(2)

obj2 <- suppressWarnings(readRDS("inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds"))

a2 <- attributes(obj2)

padj2 <- a2$listData$padj
names2 <- a2$rownames

keep1 <- !is.na(padj1) & padj1 < 0.05 & abs(lfc1) > 1.5
keep2 <- !is.na(padj2) & padj2 < 0.05 & abs(lfc2) > 1.5

# Output results as JSON
res <- list(
  iron_depleted_genes = as.character(names1[keep1]),
  innate_media_genes = as.character(names2[keep2]),
  all_genes = as.character(names1),
  n_total = length(names1),
  n_iron_de = sum(keep1),
  n_innate_de = sum(keep2)
)

cat(jsonlite::toJSON(res))
'''

    ['Rscript', '-e', r_script],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60
)

# Parse JSON output (may have loading messages mixed in)
output = result.stdout + result.stderr
# Find the JSON part
json_start = output.find('{')
json_end = output.rfind('}') + 1

    print(f"Total genes: {de_data['n_total']}")
    print(f"Iron-depleted DE genes: {de_data['n_iron_de']}")
    print(f"Innate media DE genes: {de_data['n_innate_de']}")
else:
    print("Failed to parse JSON from R output")
    print("R output:", output)
    exit(1)

iron_de = de_data['iron_depleted_genes']
innate_de = de_data['innate_media_genes']
all_genes = de_data['all_genes']

# Step 2: Get KEGG pathway-gene mapping
# ============================================================

    for i in range(retries):
        try:

            if r.status_code == 200:
                return r.text
            time.sleep(2)
        except:

    return None

    parts = line.strip().split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 2:

        gene = parts[1].strip()  # pau:PA14_XXXXX
        if pw not in pw2genes:
            pw2genes[pw] = set()
        pw2genes[pw].add(gene)

    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        pid = parts[0].strip()
        name = re.sub(r'\s+-\s+Pseudomonas aeruginosa.*', '', parts[1].strip())

print(f"Innate FG mapped: {len(innate_fg)} / {len(innate_de)}")

        }

print(f"Innate media significant pathways: {len(innate_sig)}")

print(f"\n=== ANSWER ===")
print(f"Number of pathways significantly enriched under iron-depleted but NOT under innate media: {len(iron_only)}")

    results = {}
    universe_size = len(universe)
    fg_size = len(fg)
    
    for pw, pw_genes in pw2genes.items():
        a = len(pw_genes & fg)
        if a == 0:
            continue
        b = len(pw_genes) - a
        c = fg_size - a
        d = universe_size - a - b - c
        table = [[a, b], [c, d]]
        odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact(table, alternative='two-sided')
        results[pw] = {
            'pathway': pw,
            'name': pw_name.get(pw, pw),
            'count': a,
            'pw_size': len(pw_genes),
            'pvalue': p_value,
            'or': odds_ratio
        }
    return results

innate_results = ora(innate_fg, universe, pathways_in_universe)

innate_sig = {pw: r for pw, r in innate_results.items() if r['padj'] < 0.05}

innate_fg = set(to_kegg(g) for g in innate_de) & all_kegg_genes

from scipy.stats import hypergeom, fisher_exact
import numpy as np

# Verify Fisher vs hypergeometric
# Siderophore pathway in iron
N, K, n, k = 2041, 9, 98, 6
# Hypergeometric: P(X >= k)
hg_pval = hypergeom.sf(k-1, N, K, n)
# Fisher: table [[a,b],[c,d]]
a, b, c, d = 6, 3, 92, 1940
_, fish_pval = fisher_exact([[a, b], [c, d]], alternative='greater')
print(f"Siderophore: hypergeom pval={hg_pval:.6e}, Fisher pval={fish_pval:.6e}")

# Secondary metabolites in iron
N, K, n, k = 2041, 444, 98, 35
hg_pval2 = hypergeom.sf(k-1, N, K, n)
a2, b2, c2, d2 = 35, 409, 63, 1534
_, fish_pval2 = fisher_exact([[a2, b2], [c2, d2]], alternative='greater')
print(f"Secondary metabolites: hypergeom pval={hg_pval2:.6e}, Fisher pval={fish_pval2:.6e}")

# Also check: Biofilm formation in innate (1/108 with 252 FG)
N, K, n, k = 2041, 108, 252, 1
hg_pval3 = hypergeom.sf(k-1, N, K, n)
# For comparison, also enrichment direction:
exp = n * K / N
print(f"\nBiofilm formation: expected={exp:.1f}, observed={k}, enrichment? {k > exp}")
# This is clear depletion - observed << expected
a3, b3, c3, d3 = 1, 107, 251, 1682
_, fish_pval3 = fisher_exact([[a3, b3], [c3, d3]], alternative='greater')
print(f"Biofilm formation (one-sided enrichment): Fisher pval={fish_pval3:.6e}")
_, fish_pval3b = fisher_exact([[a3, b3], [c3, d3]], alternative='less')
print(f"Biofilm formation (one-sided depletion): Fisher pval={fish_pval3b:.6e}")

# Conclusion
print("\nConclusion: one-sided Fisher (greater) correctly identifies enrichment only")
PYEOF

res1 <- readRDS("inputs/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.rds")
res2 <- readRDS("inputs/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.rds")

save_csv <- function(res, path) {
  ld <- attr(res, "listData")
  rn <- attr(res, "rownames")
  df <- data.frame(
    gene = rn,
    baseMean = ld$baseMean,
    log2FoldChange = ld$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE = ld$lfcSE,
    stat = ld$stat,
    pvalue = ld$pvalue,
    padj = ld$padj,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(df, path, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved", path, ":", nrow(df), "rows\n")
}

save_csv(res1, "/workspace/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.csv")
save_csv(res2, "/workspace/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.csv")
cat("Done\n")

parameters.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
KEGG Pathway Enrichment Analysis for P. aeruginosa PA14
Compares iron-depleted (GluFe vs GluFePlus) vs innate media (Succ vs GluFePlus)
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import re

# 1. Load DEG results
print("Loading DEG results...")
glufe = pd.read_csv("/workspace/res_GluFevsGluFePlus.csv")  # Iron-depleted
succ = pd.read_csv("/workspace/res_SuccvsGluFePlus.csv")    # Innate media

print(f"GluFe (iron-depleted) rows: {len(glufe)}")
print(f"Succ (innate media) rows: {len(succ)}")

# 2. Filter DEGs: |log2FC| > 1.5 and padj < 0.05
glufe_deg = glufe[(glufe['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 1.5) & (glufe['padj'] < 0.05)].copy()
succ_deg = succ[(succ['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 1.5) & (succ['padj'] < 0.05)].copy()

print(f"\nGluFe DEGs (|log2FC|>1.5, padj<0.05): {len(glufe_deg)}")
print(f"Succ DEGs (|log2FC|>1.5, padj<0.05): {len(succ_deg)}")

# 3. Load KEGG pathway-gene links
print("\nLoading KEGG pathway-gene links...")
pathway_links = pd.read_csv("/workspace/pau_pathway_links.txt", sep="\t", header=None, names=["pathway", "gene"])
print(f"Total links: {len(pathway_links)}")

# Parse gene IDs: pau:PA14_XXXXX -> PA14_XXXXX
pathway_links['gene_id'] = pathway_links['gene'].str.replace('pau:', '')
# Parse pathway IDs: path:pauXXXXX -> pauXXXXX
pathway_links['pathway_id'] = pathway_links['pathway'].str.replace('path:', '')

# Build pathway -> gene set mapping
pathway_to_genes = {}
for pid, group in pathway_links.groupby('pathway_id'):
    pathway_to_genes[pid] = set(group['gene_id'])

# Load pathway names
pathway_names = pd.read_csv("/workspace/pau_pathway_names.txt", sep="\t", header=None, names=["pathway_id", "name"])
pathway_name_map = dict(zip(pathway_names['pathway_id'], pathway_names['name']))

print(f"Pathways: {len(pathway_to_genes)}")

# 4. Build universe and DEG sets
# Universe = all genes in the results
universe = set(glufe['gene'].tolist())
print(f"Universe size: {len(universe)}")

glufe_deg_set = set(glufe_deg['gene'].tolist())
succ_deg_set = set(succ_deg['gene'].tolist())

# Restrict universe to genes that appear in at least one KEGG pathway
genes_in_any_pathway = set()
for genes in pathway_to_genes.values():
    genes_in_any_pathway.update(genes)
genes_in_any_pathway = genes_in_any_pathway & universe
print(f"Genes in universe AND in at least one KEGG pathway: {len(genes_in_any_pathway)}")

# 5. Run ORA for each condition
def run_ora(deg_set, pathway_to_genes, universe, pathway_name_map):
    """
    Over-Representation Analysis using Fisher's exact test.
    Universe = all genes in DESeq2 results that are annotated in KEGG.
    """
    # Restrict universe to genes that appear in KEGG pathways
    universe_kegg = set()
    for genes in pathway_to_genes.values():
        universe_kegg.update(genes)
    universe_kegg = universe_kegg & universe

    universe_size = len(universe_kegg)
    deg_in_universe = deg_set & universe_kegg
    deg_size = len(deg_in_universe)

    print(f"  DEGs in KEGG-universe: {deg_size}")

    results = []
    for pathway_id, pathway_genes in pathway_to_genes.items():
        pathway_genes_in_universe = pathway_genes & universe_kegg

        if len(pathway_genes_in_universe) < 2:
            continue  # Skip pathways with too few genes

        # Contingency table:
        #                      DEG    Not DEG
        # In pathway           a      b
        # Not in pathway       c      d

        a = len(pathway_genes_in_universe & deg_in_universe)  # DEGs in pathway
        b = len(pathway_genes_in_universe) - a                # Non-DEGs in pathway
        c = deg_size - a                                       # DEGs not in pathway
        d = universe_size - deg_size - b                       # Non-DEGs not in pathway

        # Fisher's exact test (one-sided, greater - testing for enrichment)
        # Use two-sided and then check direction, or one-sided "greater"
        # Standard ORA uses one-sided "greater" to test for enrichment
        _, p_value = fisher_exact([[a, b], [c, d]], alternative='greater')

        results.append({
            'pathway_id': pathway_id,
            'pathway_name': pathway_name_map.get(pathway_id, ''),
            'pathway_size': len(pathway_genes_in_universe),
            'deg_in_pathway': a,
            'total_deg': deg_size,
            'p_value': p_value
        })

    results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
    if len(results_df) > 0:
        # Multiple testing correction (Benjamini-Hochberg)
        _, padj, _, _ = multipletests(results_df['p_value'], method='fdr_bh')
        results_df['padj'] = padj
        results_df = results_df.sort_values('padj')

    return results_df

print("\n=== GluFe (Iron-depleted) ORA ===")
glufe_ora = run_ora(glufe_deg_set, pathway_to_genes, universe, pathway_name_map)
print(f"Total pathways tested: {len(glufe_ora)}")
print(f"Significant (padj<0.05): {len(glufe_ora[glufe_ora['padj'] < 0.05])}")
print("\nTop significant pathways (GluFe):")
print(glufe_ora[glufe_ora['padj'] < 0.05][['pathway_id', 'pathway_name', 'pathway_size', 'deg_in_pathway', 'padj']].to_string())

print("\n=== Succ (Innate media) ORA ===")
succ_ora = run_ora(succ_deg_set, pathway_to_genes, universe, pathway_name_map)
print(f"Total pathways tested: {len(succ_ora)}")
print(f"Significant (padj<0.05): {len(succ_ora[succ_ora['padj'] < 0.05])}")
print("\nTop significant pathways (Succ):")
print(succ_ora[succ_ora['padj'] < 0.05][['pathway_id', 'pathway_name', 'pathway_size', 'deg_in_pathway', 'padj']].to_string())

# 6. Compare: pathways significant in GluFe but NOT in Succ
glufe_sig = set(glufe_ora[glufe_ora['padj'] < 0.05]['pathway_id'])
succ_sig = set(succ_ora[succ_ora['padj'] < 0.05]['pathway_id'])

only_glufe_sig = glufe_sig - succ_sig
only_succ_sig = succ_sig - glufe_sig
both_sig = glufe_sig & succ_sig

print(f"\n=== Comparison ===")
print(f"Significant in GluFe only (iron-depleted specific): {len(only_glufe_sig)}")
print(f"Significant in Succ only (innate media specific): {len(only_succ_sig)}")
print(f"Significant in both: {len(both_sig)}")

if only_glufe_sig:
    print(f"\nPathways significant ONLY in GluFe (iron-depleted):")
    for pid in sorted(only_glufe_sig):
        info = glufe_ora[glufe_ora['pathway_id'] == pid].iloc[0]
        print(f"  {pid} {info['pathway_name']}: padj={info['padj']:.4e}, DEGs={info['deg_in_pathway']}/{info['pathway_size']}")

# 7. Write answer
answer = len(only_glufe_sig)
print(f"\nANSWER: {answer}")

with open("/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(str(answer))

print("Answer written to codex_output/answer.txt")

    X=np.array([[float(x) for x in row[1:]] for row in csv.reader(f)], dtype=float)
# fit function centered, full SVD, ratio using eigenvalues/total variance
def pca_ratio(Xsamples):
    Y=np.log10(Xsamples+1.0)
    Yc=Y-Y.mean(axis=0)
    # zero variance features
    var=Yc.var(axis=0, ddof=0)
    Yz=Yc[:,var>1e-15]
    # SVD of centered matrix; eigenvalues = s"'^2/n if ddof=0 denominator n
    n,p=Yz.shape
    # scikit-learn divides by n for variance, PCA uses n (not n-1)
    U,s,Vt=svd(Yz, full_matrices=False)
    eig=s*s/n
    total=np.sum(Yz.var(axis=0,ddof=0))
    ratio=eig/total
    return ratio[0]*100, ratio[:100].sum(), n, p

import csv, numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
with open('inputs/ROSMAP_genexp_ad.csv', newline='') as f:
    header=next(csv.reader(f))
    n_samples=len(header)-1
    X=np.array([[float(v) for v in row[1:]] for row in csv.reader(f)], dtype=float)
print('raw shape',X.shape,'samples',n_samples,'genes',X.shape[0],'NaN',np.isnan(X).any())
Y=np.log10(X.T + 1.0)  # samples x genes
print('Y',Y.shape,'finite',np.isfinite(Y).all(),'zero genes after log',np.sum(Y.var(axis=0)==0))
pca=PCA(n_components=100, svd_solver='full')
pca.fit(Y)
pc1=pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]
total_ratio=pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum()
print('PC1 ratio',repr(pc1),'percent',pc1*100)
print('sum first100 ratios',total_ratio)
print('PC1 eigenvalue',pca.explained_variance_[0],'sum eigenvalues all?',pca.explained_variance_.sum())
# denominator should be trace of centered covariance / n using np.cov ddof=0
Z=Y-Y.mean(axis=0)
denom=np.sum(Z*Z)/Y.shape[0]
print('denom trace',denom,'eig/denom',pca.explained_variance_[0]/denom)
# compare singular value squared/n
U,s,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Z,full_matrices=False)
print('svd first ratio',(s[0]**2/Y.shape[0])/denom)
print('all svd sum',np.sum(s**2/Y.shape[0])/denom)

import os, tempfile

api_key = open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

hda_id = 'f9cad7b01a472135cbd86b21ab3a6398'

with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.csv', delete=False) as f:
    gi.datasets.download_dataset(hda_id, file_path=f.name, use_default_filename=False)
    with open(f.name, 'r') as infile:
        lines = infile.readlines()
    
    # Parse header
    header = lines[0].strip().split(',')
    print(f"Header: first field='{header[0]}', total fields={len(header)}")
    print(f"First 5 sample IDs: {header[1:6]}")
    print(f"Last 3 sample IDs: {header[-3:]}")
    
    # Check first few data rows
    print("\nFirst 3 data rows (gene and first 3 values):")
    for i in range(1, min(4, len(lines))):
        parts = lines[i].strip().split(',')
        print(f"  Gene: {parts[0]}, values: {parts[1:4]}")
    
    # Check for zeros and min values
    import sys
    min_val = float('inf')
    max_val = float('-inf')
    zero_count = 0
    total_count = 0
    for i in range(1, len(lines)):
        parts = lines[i].strip().split(',')
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        for v in parts[1:]:
            try:
                val = float(v)
                total_count += 1
                if val < min_val:
                    min_val = val
                if val > max_val:
                    max_val = val
                if val == 0:
                    zero_count += 1
            except:
                pass
    
    print(f"\nTotal numeric values checked: {total_count}")
    print(f"Min value: {min_val}")
    print(f"Max value: {max_val}")
    print(f"Zero count: {zero_count}")
    
    # Number of genes (data rows)
    gene_count = sum(1 for l in lines[1:] if l.strip())
    print(f"\nNumber of genes: {gene_count}")
    print(f"Number of samples (columns - 1): {len(header) - 1}")
    
    os.unlink(f.name)

import sys, csv, math
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

# Read TSV data
with open(sys.argv[1], 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter='\t')
    header = next(reader)
    
    # First column is "gene" (label), rest are gene names
    gene_names = header[1:]
    
    sample_ids = []
    data_rows = []
    for row in reader:
        if not row or len(row) < 2:
            continue
        sample_ids.append(row[0])
        data_rows.append([float(v) for v in row[1:]])
    
    data = np.array(data_rows)  # shape: (n_samples, n_genes)

print(f"Data shape: {data.shape}", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"Samples: {len(sample_ids)}, Genes: {len(gene_names)}", file=sys.stderr)

# Add pseudocount 1 and log10 transform
data_transformed = np.log10(data + 1.0)

# Verify no inf/nan
n_inf = np.sum(np.isinf(data_transformed))
n_nan = np.sum(np.isnan(data_transformed))
print(f"Inf values: {n_inf}, NaN values: {n_nan}", file=sys.stderr)

# Run PCA with 100 components
n_components = min(100, data_transformed.shape[0], data_transformed.shape[1])
pca = PCA(n_components=n_components)
pca.fit(data_transformed)

# Output explained variance ratios
# Header
print("PC\tExplainedVarianceRatio\tCumulativeVarianceRatio")
cumulative = 0.0
for i, ratio in enumerate(pca.explained_variance_ratio_):
    cumulative += ratio
    print(f"PC{i+1}\t{ratio}\t{cumulative}")

# Also output total variance and first PC ratio to stderr for easy capture
print(f"PC1 explains {pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]*100:.6f}% of total variance", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"Total variance explained by {n_components} PCs: {sum(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)*100:.6f}%", file=sys.stderr)
'''

# Base64 encode the script
script_b64 = base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode()
print(script_b64)

import csv
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from collections import defaultdict

# ---- 1. Read metadata and identify collisions vs aggregates ----
meta_rows = []
with open('/workspace/inputs/ROSMAP_meta_ad.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        meta_rows.append(row)

meta_by_id = defaultdict(list)
for row in meta_rows:
    meta_by_id[row['projid']].append(row)

# Identify collision groups vs aggregate groups
collision_ids = set()
aggregate_ids = {}  # id -> list of row indices to average

for pid, rows in meta_by_id.items():
    if len(rows) <= 1:
        continue
    # Check invariant attributes: msex, educ, apoe_genotype
    invariant_keys = ['msex', 'educ', 'apoe_genotype']
    all_match = True
    for key in invariant_keys:
        vals = set(r[key] for r in rows)
        if len(vals) > 1:
            all_match = False
            break
    if all_match:
        aggregate_ids[pid] = len(rows)
    else:
        collision_ids.add(pid)

print("Collision IDs (exclude all occurrences):", sorted(collision_ids))
print("Aggregate IDs (average):", aggregate_ids)
print(f"Total collision IDs: {len(collision_ids)}")
print(f"Total aggregate IDs: {len(aggregate_ids)}")

# ---- 2. Read expression matrix ----
with open('/workspace/inputs/ROSMAP_genexp_ad.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    
sample_ids = header[1:]  # skip the 'gene' label
gene_names = []
data_rows = []
for row in reader:
    gene_names.append(row[0])
    data_rows.append([float(x) for x in row[1:]])

# Matrix: genes x samples
X_raw = np.array(data_rows)  # shape: (n_genes, n_samples)
n_genes, n_samples = X_raw.shape
print(f"\nExpression matrix: {n_genes} genes x {n_samples} samples")
print(f"Sample IDs (first 10): {sample_ids[:10]}")

# Build index map: sample_id -> list of column indices
sample_idx_map = defaultdict(list)
for i, sid in enumerate(sample_ids):
    sample_idx_map[sid].append(i)

print(f"Unique sample IDs in expression data: {len(sample_idx_map)}")

# ---- 3. Resolve duplicates in expression data ----
# Strategy:
# - Exclude all columns where sample_id is in collision_ids
# - Average columns where sample_id is in aggregate_ids
# - Keep single-occurrence samples as-is

cols_to_keep = []  # list of (sample_id, column_index_or_list)
for sid, indices in sorted(sample_idx_map.items()):
    if sid in collision_ids:
        # Exclude entirely
        continue
    elif sid in aggregate_ids:
        # Average the columns
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices))
    else:
        # Single occurrence
        assert len(indices) == 1, f"Expected 1 occurrence for {sid}, got {len(indices)}"
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices[0]))

print(f"\nSamples after resolution: {len(cols_to_keep)}")

# Build the resolved expression matrix (genes x resolved_samples)
resolved_samples = []
resolved_data = np.zeros((n_genes, len(cols_to_keep)))
for j, (sid, col_info) in enumerate(cols_to_keep):
    resolved_samples.append(sid)
    if isinstance(col_info, list):
        # Average the columns
        resolved_data[:, j] = X_raw[:, col_info].mean(axis=1)
    else:
        resolved_data[:, j] = X_raw[:, col_info]

print(f"Resolved matrix: {resolved_data.shape[1]} samples x {resolved_data.shape[0]} genes")

# ---- 4. Transpose: samples as rows, genes as columns ----
X = resolved_data.T  # shape: (n_samples, n_genes)
print(f"Transposed: {X.shape[0]} samples (rows) x {X.shape[1]} genes (columns)")

# ---- 5. log10(x + 1) transform ----
X_log = np.log10(X + 1)
print(f"After log10(x+1): min={X_log.min():.4f}, max={X_log.max():.4f}")

# ---- 6. Remove zero-variance genes ----
gene_vars = np.var(X_log, axis=0)
nzv_mask = gene_vars > 0
print(f"Zero-variance genes removed: {(~nzv_mask).sum()} out of {len(gene_vars)}")
X_filt = X_log[:, nzv_mask]
print(f"Filtered matrix: {X_filt.shape}")

# ---- 7. Center features (genes) ----
# Standard PCA: center the features (columns)
X_centered = X_filt - X_filt.mean(axis=0)
print(f"Centered: mean per gene approx 0, abs max mean: {np.abs(X_centered.mean(axis=0)).max():.2e}")

# ---- 8. PCA with 100 components ----
pca = PCA(n_components=100)
pca.fit(X_centered)

# ---- 9. Extract PC1 explained variance ratio ----
explained_var_ratios = pca.explained_variance_ratio_
pc1_var_pct = explained_var_ratios[0] * 100

print(f"\n===== RESULTS =====")
print(f"PC1 explained variance ratio: {explained_var_ratios[0]:.6f}")
print(f"PC1 percentage of total variance: {pc1_var_pct:.4f}%")
print(f"Sum of {len(explained_var_ratios)} PCs explained variance: {explained_var_ratios.sum():.4f}")
print(f"Total variance (sum of eigenvalues / n_features): {sum(pca.explained_variance_ / pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0] * pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]) if False else 'N/A'}")

# Verify denominator: sum of all eigenvalues = total variance
# explained_variance_ratio_[i] = explained_variance_[i] / sum of all eigenvalues
# So sum of explained_variance_ is the total variance of retained components
print(f"Sum of explained_variance_: {pca.explained_variance_.sum():.4f}")
print(f"Total variance (trace of covariance matrix): {np.var(X_centered, axis=0).sum():.4f}")
PYEOF

import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from collections import defaultdict

    for key in invariant_keys:
        vals = set(r[key] for r in rows)
        if len(vals) > 1:
            all_match = False
            break
    if all_match:
        aggregate_ids[pid] = len(rows)
    else:
        collision_ids.add(pid)

print("Collision IDs (exclude):", sorted(collision_ids))
print("Aggregate IDs (average):", aggregate_ids)

# ---- 2. Read expression matrix ----
with open('/workspace/inputs/ROSMAP_genexp_ad.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)

sample_ids = header[1:]  # skip the 'gene' label
gene_names = []
data_rows = []
for row in reader:
    gene_names.append(row[0])
    data_rows.append([float(x) for x in row[1:]])

cols_to_keep = []
for sid, indices in sorted(sample_idx_map.items()):
    if sid in collision_ids:
        continue
    elif sid in aggregate_ids:
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices))
    else:
        assert len(indices) == 1, f"Expected 1 for {sid}, got {len(indices)}. Collision? {sid in collision_ids}"
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices[0]))

print(f"Samples after resolution: {len(cols_to_keep)}")

for j, (sid, col_info) in enumerate(cols_to_keep):

    else:
        resolved_data[:, j] = X_raw[:, col_info]

gene_vars = np.var(X_log, axis=0)
nzv_mask = gene_vars > 0
print(f"Zero-variance genes: {(~nzv_mask).sum()} out of {len(gene_vars)}")
X_filt = X_log[:, nzv_mask]
print(f"Filtered: {X_filt.shape}")

# ---- 7. Center features (genes) ----
gene_means = X_filt.mean(axis=0)
X_centered = X_filt - gene_means
print(f"Centered: max abs gene mean = {np.abs(gene_means).max():.2e}")

# ---- 8. PCA with 100 components ----
pca = PCA(n_components=100, svd_solver='auto')
pca.fit(X_centered)

# ---- 9. Results ----
print(f"\n===== PCA RESULTS =====")
print(f"PC1 explained variance ratio: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]:.10f}")
print(f"PC1 % of total variance: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0] * 100:.6f}%")
print(f"Sum of first 100 PCs: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.6f}")
print(f"Number of components: {pca.n_components_}")

# Sanity: total variance = trace of covariance matrix
total_var = np.var(X_centered, axis=0).sum()
print(f"Total variance (trace): {total_var:.4f}")
print(f"Sum explained_var_: {pca.explained_variance_.sum():.4f}")
print(f"Ratio check: {pca.explained_variance_.sum() / total_var:.6f}")

# Check: sklearn's explained_variance_ratio_ sums correctly
print(f"explained_variance_ratio_ sum: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.6f}")

# Show top 5 PCs
for i in range(5):
    print(f"PC{i+1}: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_[i]*100:.4f}% (cumulative: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_[:i+1].sum()*100:.4f}%)")

# ---- 4. Transpose: samples as rows, genes as columns ----
X = resolved_data.T
print(f"Transposed: {X.shape[0]} samples x {X.shape[1]} genes")

# ---- 5. log10(x + 1) transform ----
X_log = np.log10(X + 1)
print(f"After log10(x+1): min={X_log.min():.4f}, max={X_log.max():.4f}")

# ---- 6. Remove zero-variance genes ----
gene_vars = np.var(X_log, axis=0)
nzv_mask = gene_vars > 0
print(f"Zero-variance genes: {(~nzv_mask).sum()} out of {len(gene_vars)}")
X_filt = X_log[:, nzv_mask]
print(f"Filtered: {X_filt.shape}")

# ---- 7. Center features ----
gene_means = X_filt.mean(axis=0)
X_centered = X_filt - gene_means
print(f"Centered: max abs gene mean = {np.abs(gene_means).max():.2e}")

# ---- 8. PCA with 100 components ----
pca = PCA(n_components=100)
pca.fit(X_centered)

# ---- 9. Results ----

print(f"Sum explained_var_ (100 PCs): {pca.explained_variance_.sum():.6f}")
print(f"explained_variance_ratio_ sum (100 PCs): {pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.6f}")

for i in range(5):
    print(f"PC{i+1}: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_[i]*100:.4f}%  "

for pid, rows in meta_by_id.items():
    if len(rows) <= 1:
        continue
    invariant_keys = ['msex', 'educ', 'apoe_genotype']
    all_match = all(len(set(r[k] for r in rows)) == 1 for k in invariant_keys)

for i, sid in enumerate(sample_ids):
    sample_idx_map[sid].append(i)

# Resolve duplicates
cols_to_keep = []
for sid in sorted(sample_idx_map.keys()):
    indices = sample_idx_map[sid]
    if sid in collision_ids:
        continue
    elif sid in aggregate_ids:
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices))
    else:

for j, (sid, col_info) in enumerate(cols_to_keep):

print(f"N samples: {X_c.shape[0]}, N genes: {X_c.shape[1]}")

book=xlrd.open_workbook('inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls')
s=book.sheet_by_index(0)
rows=[]
for r in range(2,s.nrows):
    name=s.cell_value(r,0)
    vals=[]
    for c in range(1,s.ncols):
        v=s.cell_value(r,c)
        if isinstance(v,str) and v.strip().upper()=='NAN':
            vals.append(None)
        else:
            vals.append(float(v))
    rows.append([name, vals[:10], vals[10:20]])
# Use R for exact base t.test/p.adjust semantics.
r_code = r'''
con <- file(\"stdin\")
obj <- jsonlite::fromJSON(readLines(con, warn=FALSE))
close(con)
p_welch <- numeric(length(obj))
p_student <- numeric(length(obj))
p_paired <- numeric(length(obj))
for (i in seq_along(obj)) {
  p <- unlist(obj[[i]][[2]])
  c <- unlist(obj[[i]][[3]])
  p <- as.numeric(p); c <- as.numeric(c)
  p_welch[i] <- t.test(p, c)"'$p.value
  p_student[i] <- t.test(p, c, var.equal=TRUE)$p.value
  good <- !(is.na(p) | is.na(c))
  p_paired[i] <- t.test(p[good], c[good], paired=TRUE)$p.value
}
for (label in c('"'welch','student','paired')) {
  pv <- get(paste0('p_', label))
  cat(label, 'raw<=0.05', sum(pv <= 0.05),
      'bonf', sum(p.adjust(pv, method='bonferroni') <= 0.05),
      'BY', sum(p.adjust(pv, method='BY') <= 0.05), '\\n')
}
'''

proc = subprocess.run(['Rscript','-e','cat(requireNamespace(\"jsonlite\", quietly=TRUE))'], text=True, capture_output=True)
if proc.stdout.strip() == 'TRUE':
    out = subprocess.run(['Rscript','-e',r_code], input=json.dumps(rows), text=True, capture_output=True)
    print(out.stdout, end='')
    if out.stderr: print(out.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(out.returncode)
# Fallback: tab-separated rows with semicolon-separated values, NA for missing.
lines=[]
for name,p,c in rows:
    def fmt(xs): return ';'.join('NA' if x is None else repr(x) for x in xs)
    lines.append(name+'\\t'+fmt(p)+'\\t'+fmt(c))
r_code2 = r'''
d <- read.delim('stdin', header=FALSE, sep='\\t', stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
parsev <- function(x) as.numeric(strsplit(x, ';', fixed=TRUE)[[1]])
p_welch <- numeric(nrow(d)); p_student <- numeric(nrow(d)); p_paired <- numeric(nrow(d))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(d))) {

}
for (label in c('"'welch','student','paired')) {
  pv <- get(paste0('p_', label))
  cat(label, 'raw<=0.05', sum(pv <= 0.05),
      'bonf', sum(p.adjust(pv, method='bonferroni') <= 0.05),
      'BY', sum(p.adjust(pv, method='BY') <= 0.05), '\\n')
}
'''
out = subprocess.run(['Rscript','-e',r_code2], input='\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n', text=True, capture_output=True)
print(out.stdout, end='')
if out.stderr: print(out.stderr, file=sys.stderr)

PY"
