representation.name: Swarm R polynomial and natural spline comparison
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
d <- read.csv(args[1], stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber","Ratio","Area")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Missing required columns")
if (anyNA(d[required])) stop("Missing model fields")
parts <- strsplit(d[["Ratio"]], ":", fixed=TRUE)
if (any(lengths(parts) != 2L)) stop("Invalid ratio encoding")
num <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[1]), numeric(1))
den <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[2]), numeric(1))
if (any(!is.finite(num)) || any(!is.finite(den)) || any(num + den <= 0)) stop("Invalid ratio values")
d[["p287"]] <- num/(num+den)
mix <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287_98", c("Area","p287")]
names(mix) <- c("area","p")
if (nrow(mix) != 36L) stop("Unexpected mixture row count")
if (length(unique(mix[["p"]])) != 12L) stop("Unexpected mixture frequency count")
pure287 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287", "Area", drop=TRUE]
pure98 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "98", "Area", drop=TRUE]
if (length(pure287) != 3L || length(pure98) != 3L) stop("Unexpected pure endpoint counts")
complete <- rbind(mix, data.frame(area=pure98,p=0), data.frame(area=pure287,p=1))

find_optimum <- function(fit, lo, hi) {
  grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=10001L)
  yg <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p=grid)))
  local <- which(yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[1:(length(yg)-2L)] &
                 yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[3:length(yg)]) + 1L
  cand_p <- c(lo, hi)
  for (i in local) {
    left <- grid[max(1L, i-1L)]
    right <- grid[min(length(grid), i+1L)]
    z <- optimize(function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))),
                  interval=c(left,right), maximum=TRUE, tol=1e-12)
    cand_p <- c(cand_p, z[["maximum"]])
  }
  cand_y <- vapply(cand_p, function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))), numeric(1))
  j <- which.max(cand_y)
  c(optimal_p=cand_p[j], predicted_max=cand_y[j])
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope) {
  fits <- list(
    quadratic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2), data=dat),
    cubic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data=dat),
    natural_spline_df4=lm(area ~ splines::ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  nobs_vec <- vapply(fits, nobs, numeric(1))
  if (length(unique(nobs_vec)) != 1L || nobs_vec[1] != nrow(dat)) stop("Candidate models used different rows")
  aics <- vapply(fits, AIC, numeric(1))
  best <- names(fits)[which.min(aics)]
  opts <- lapply(fits, find_optimum, lo=min(dat[["p"]]), hi=max(dat[["p"]]))
  data.frame(
    scope=scope,
    model=names(fits),
    n=as.integer(nobs_vec),
    parameter_count=vapply(fits,function(x) as.integer(attr(logLik(x),"df")),integer(1)),
    aic=as.numeric(aics),
    optimal_p=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["optimal_p"]],numeric(1)),
    predicted_max=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["predicted_max"]],numeric(1)),
    best_by_min_aic=names(fits)==best,
    domain_min=min(dat[["p"]]),
    domain_max=max(dat[["p"]]),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}

res <- rbind(fit_scope(mix,"mixtures_only"),fit_scope(complete,"mixtures_plus_pure_endpoints"))
write.table(res,file="model_results.tsv",sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE,digits=15)
chosen <- res[res[["scope"]]=="mixtures_only" & res[["best_by_min_aic"]],]
if (nrow(chosen) != 1L) stop("Best model selection failed")
writeLines(format(round(chosen[["predicted_max"]],6),scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE,nsmall=0),con="answer.txt")
RSCRIPT
Rscript job.R "$(inputs.input.path)"

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript - "$(inputs.input_csv.path)" <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1) stop("Expected exactly one CSV input path")
input_path <- args[[1]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))

d <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) stop(paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))

strain <- as.character(d$StrainNumber)
ratio <- as.character(d$Ratio)
area <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d$Area)))
if (any(!is.finite(area))) stop("Area contains non-finite values")

is_mix <- strain == "287_98"
is_98 <- strain == "98"
is_287 <- strain == "287"
keep <- is_mix | is_98 | is_287
if (!any(keep)) stop("No 287_98 mixture or matching pure endpoint rows found")

p287 <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))
p287[is_98] <- 0
p287[is_287] <- 1

mix_idx <- which(is_mix)
parts <- strsplit(ratio[mix_idx], ":", fixed = TRUE)
if (length(parts) == 0 || any(lengths(parts) != 2)) stop("Mixture ratios are not two-component ratios")
p287[mix_idx] <- vapply(parts, function(z) {
  a <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[1]]))
  b <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[2]]))
  if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b) || a < 0 || b < 0 || a + b <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  a / (a + b)
}, numeric(1))

if (any(!is.finite(p287[keep])) || any(p287[keep] < 0 | p287[keep] > 1)) {
  stop("Invalid strain-287 proportions")
}

fit_data <- data.frame(area = area[keep], p = p287[keep])
interior_data <- data.frame(area = area[is_mix], p = p287[is_mix])
if (nrow(fit_data) < 10 || nrow(interior_data) < 10) stop("Unexpectedly small analysis sets")

find_maximum <- function(fit, lower, upper) {
  grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 20001)
  grid_pred <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = grid)))
  n <- length(grid_pred)
  local_max <- which(
    (seq_len(n) == 1 | grid_pred >= c(-Inf, grid_pred[-n])) &
    (seq_len(n) == n | grid_pred >= c(grid_pred[-1], -Inf))
  )
  candidates <- lapply(local_max, function(i) {
    if (i == 1 || i == n) {
      return(c(p = grid[[i]], y = grid_pred[[i]]))
    }
    opt <- optimize(
      function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = x))),
      interval = c(grid[[i - 1]], grid[[i + 1]]),
      maximum = TRUE
    )
    c(p = opt$maximum, y = opt$objective)
  })
  candidate_matrix <- do.call(rbind, candidates)
  candidate_matrix[which.max(candidate_matrix[, "y"]), , drop = FALSE]
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope_name, lower, upper) {
  models <- list(
    quadratic = lm(area ~ p + I(p^2), data = dat),
    cubic = lm(area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = dat),
    natural_spline_df4 = lm(area ~ ns(p, df = 4), data = dat)
  )
  rows <- lapply(names(models), function(model_name) {
    fit <- models[[model_name]]
    sm <- summary(fit)
    mx <- find_maximum(fit, lower, upper)
    data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n_obs = nrow(dat),
      domain_min = lower,
      domain_max = upper,
      aic = as.numeric(AIC(fit)),
      bic = as.numeric(BIC(fit)),
      r_squared = as.numeric(sm$r.squared),
      adj_r_squared = as.numeric(sm$adj.r.squared),
      rmse = sqrt(mean(residuals(fit)^2)),
      optimal_p287 = as.numeric(mx[["p"]]),
      max_predicted_area = as.numeric(mx[["y"]]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out$aic_rank <- rank(out$aic, ties.method = "first")
  out$selected_by_AIC <- out$aic_rank == 1
  out
}

full_lower <- min(fit_data$p)
full_upper <- max(fit_data$p)
interior_lower <- min(interior_data$p)
interior_upper <- max(interior_data$p)

full_results <- fit_scope(fit_data, "full_curve_with_pure_endpoints", full_lower, full_upper)
interior_results <- fit_scope(interior_data, "interior_mixtures_only", interior_lower, interior_upper)
results <- rbind(full_results, interior_results)
results$criterion <- "AIC_lower_is_better"
results$r_version <- paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")

write.table(
  results,
  file = "model_results.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = "NA"
)

representation.name: Colony area model comparison in R
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analyze.R <<'RSCRIPT'
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, digits = 17)
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected one CSV input path")
input_path <- args[[1L]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))
d <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0L) stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))

d$StrainNumber <- trimws(as.character(d$StrainNumber))
d$Ratio <- trimws(as.character(d$Ratio))
d$Replicate <- trimws(as.character(d$Replicate))
d$Area <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d$Area)))
if (any(!is.finite(d$Area))) stop("Area contains non-finite values")

d$p287 <- NA_real_
is_mix <- d$StrainNumber == "287_98"
mix_parts <- strsplit(d$Ratio[is_mix], ":", fixed = TRUE)
if (length(mix_parts) > 0L) {
  if (any(lengths(mix_parts) != 2L)) stop("Mixture ratios must have exactly two components")
  a <- vapply(mix_parts, function(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[1L]])), numeric(1))
  b <- vapply(mix_parts, function(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[2L]])), numeric(1))
  if (any(!is.finite(a)) || any(!is.finite(b)) || any(a < 0) || any(b < 0) || any(a + b <= 0)) {
    stop("Invalid mixture ratio")
  }
  d$p287[is_mix] <- a / (a + b)
}
d$p287[d$StrainNumber == "98" & !is_mix] <- 0
d$p287[d$StrainNumber == "287" & !is_mix] <- 1

component_system <- d$StrainNumber %in% c("98", "287", "287_98")
if (any(d$StrainNumber == "1")) {
  # Strain 1 is an unrelated pure control and is not part of the 287_98 curve.
}
if (any(!component_system & d$StrainNumber != "1")) {
  stop("Unexpected strain labels outside the 287_98 system")
}

primary <- d[component_system & is.finite(d$Area) & is.finite(d$p287), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(primary) != 45L) stop(paste("Unexpected primary row count:", nrow(primary)))
if (length(unique(primary$Replicate)) != 3L) stop("Unexpected replicate structure")
if (any(primary$p287 < 0 | primary$p287 > 1)) stop("Proportion outside [0,1]")
primary$p287 <- pmin(pmax(primary$p287, 0), 1)
interior <- primary[primary$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(interior) != 36L) stop(paste("Unexpected interior row count:", nrow(interior)))

make_optimum <- function(fit, dat, ngrid = 20001L) {
  domain <- range(dat$p287)
  grid <- seq(domain[[1L]], domain[[2L]], length.out = ngrid)
  grid_pred <- as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = grid)))
  if (any(!is.finite(grid_pred))) stop("Non-finite grid prediction")
  if (ngrid >= 3L) {
    local_idx <- which(
      grid_pred[2:(ngrid - 1L)] >= grid_pred[1:(ngrid - 2L)] &
      grid_pred[2:(ngrid - 1L)] >= grid_pred[3:ngrid]
    ) + 1L
  } else {
    local_idx <- integer(0L)
  }
  candidate_idx <- unique(c(1L, ngrid, local_idx))
  refine_one <- function(i) {
    if (i == 1L || i == ngrid) {
      return(c(p = grid[[i]], predicted_area = grid_pred[[i]]))
    }
    refined <- stats::optimize(
      f = function(x) as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = x))),
      interval = c(grid[[i - 1L]], grid[[i + 1L]]),
      maximum = TRUE
    )
    c(p = refined$maximum, predicted_area = refined$objective)
  }
  candidates <- do.call(rbind, lapply(candidate_idx, refine_one))
  best <- candidates[which.max(candidates[, "predicted_area"]), , drop = FALSE]
  c(
    optimum_frequency = as.numeric(best[["p"]]),
    predicted_area = as.numeric(best[["predicted_area"]]),
    domain_min = domain[[1L]],
    domain_max = domain[[2L]]
  )
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope_name) {
  formulas <- list(
    quadratic = Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2),
    cubic = Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2) + I(p287^3),
    natural_spline_df4 = Area ~ splines::ns(p287, df = 4)
  )
  comparison_rows <- list()
  optimum_rows <- list()
  fits <- list()
  for (model_name in names(formulas)) {
    fit <- stats::lm(formulas[[model_name]], data = dat)
    fits[[model_name]] <- fit
    fit_summary <- summary(fit)
    opt <- make_optimum(fit, dat)
    comparison_rows[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),
      parameters = length(stats::coef(fit)),
      aic = as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit)),
      bic = as.numeric(stats::BIC(fit)),
      r_squared = as.numeric(fit_summary$r.squared),
      adjusted_r_squared = as.numeric(fit_summary$adj.r.squared),
      rss = as.numeric(deviance(fit)),
      optimum_frequency = opt[["optimum_frequency"]],
      predicted_area = opt[["predicted_area"]],
      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    optimum_rows[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),
      aic = as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit)),
      optimum_frequency = opt[["optimum_frequency"]],
      predicted_area = opt[["predicted_area"]],
      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  comparison <- do.call(rbind, comparison_rows)
  optimums <- do.call(rbind, optimum_rows)
  comparison$selected_by_aic <- comparison$model == comparison$model[which.min(comparison$aic)]
  optimums$selected_by_aic <- optimums$model == optimums$model[which.min(optimums$aic)]
  list(comparison = comparison, optimums = optimums, fits = fits)
}

primary_fit <- fit_scope(primary, "primary_full_boundaries")
interior_fit <- fit_scope(interior, "interior_mixtures_only")
comparison <- rbind(primary_fit$comparison, interior_fit$comparison)
optimums <- rbind(primary_fit$optimums, interior_fit$optimums)

primary_selected <- primary_fit$optimums[which.min(primary_fit$optimums$aic), , drop = FALSE]
primary_selected$selection_metric <- "minimum_AIC"
primary_selected$selection_scope <- "primary_full_boundaries"
primary_selected <- primary_selected[, c(
  "selection_scope", "selection_metric", "model", "n", "aic",
  "optimum_frequency", "predicted_area", "domain_min", "domain_max"
), drop = FALSE]

utils::write.table(
  comparison,
  file = "model_comparison.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(
  optimums,
  file = "model_optima.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(
  primary_selected,
  file = "optimal_prediction.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

Rscript --vanilla analyze.R "$(inputs.input.path)"

      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),

      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],

    )

  optimums$selected_by_aic <- optimums$model == optimums$model[which.min(optimums$aic)]
  list(comparison = comparison, optimums = optimums)

# galaxy-cli

CLI harness for the [Galaxy](https://galaxyproject.org/) bioinformatics platform.
Wraps Galaxy's REST API to provide full command-line and REPL access to histories,
datasets, tools, workflows, jobs, and libraries.

This package was initially generated with `cli-anything` and then refined into
the standalone `galaxy-cli` package.

## Prerequisites

- **Python 3.9+**
- **A running Galaxy server** — this CLI connects to Galaxy via its REST API.
  - Public: https://usegalaxy.org, https://usegalaxy.eu, https://usegalaxy.org.au
  - Local: Follow [Galaxy installation docs](https://docs.galaxyproject.org/)
- **Galaxy API key** — obtain from your Galaxy instance at `<url>/user/api_key`

## Installation

Install from PyPI with `uv` or `pip`:

```bash
uv tool install galaxy-cli
```

```bash
python3 -m pip install galaxy-cli
```

For local development from this repository:

```bash
cd agent-harness
python3 -m pip install .
```

Verify installation:

```bash
which galaxy-cli
galaxy-cl

# galaxy-cli

Use this skill when the task requires Galaxy operations through `galaxy-cli`.
Keep token use low: read this file once, then use `galaxy-cli <command> --help`
only for the specific command you are about to run.

## Token-Cheap Defaults

`galaxy-cli` is agent-first. The default path is:

1. Submit each tool with `galaxy-cli tool run ... --inputs-json FILE`.
2. Let `tool run` wait. Do not add `--no-wait` unless the task explicitly asks
   for asynchronous submission.
3. Use the returned `outputs` array for output IDs, state, datatype, and size.
4. Do not call `job show`, `dataset show`, `collection show`, `dataset list`,
   or `collection list` for routine verification.
5. Do not call `job show --logs` unless debugging a failed job.
6. Do not call `tool show` when task files already provide exact tool IDs and
   parameter JSON.

  parts <- strsplit(s, \":\", fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) "'!= 2L) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts))
  if (anyNA(vals) || any(vals < 0) || sum(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)

}

make_scope <- function(dat, lo, hi) {
  fit_models <- list(
    quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p''^2), data=dat),
    cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p''^2) + I(p''^3), data=dat),
    spline = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  rows <- list()
  for (model_name in names(fit_models)) {
    m <- fit_models[[model_name]]
    n <- length(residuals(m))
    k <- length(coef(m))
    rss <- sum(residuals(m)''^2)
    sigma <- summary(m)$sigma
    aic <- AIC(m)
    bic <- BIC(m)
    adjr2 <- summary(m)$adj.r.squared
    grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=20001L)
    pred <- predict(m, newdata=data.frame(p=grid))

      n = n,
      k = k,
      rss = rss,
      sigma = sigma,
      AIC = aic,
      BIC = bic,
      adjR2 = adjr2,
      opt_p = grid[[idx]],
      opt_pred = pred[[idx]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)

  out

library(splines)
d <- read.csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv')
# scope mixture only
dd <- d[d"'$StrainNumber=='"'287_98',]
# p from ratio, assume first component 287
spl <- strsplit(dd"'$Ratio, '"':', fixed=TRUE)
dd"'$p <- sapply(spl, function(z) as.numeric(z[1])/sum(as.numeric(z)))
cat('"'n',nrow(dd),'p range',range(dd"'$p),'"'\\n')
fit_quad <- lm(Area ~ p + I(p"'^2), data=dd)
fit_cubic <- lm(Area ~ p + I(p''^2) + I(p''^3), data=dd)
fit_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(p, df=4), data=dd)
cat('"'AIC quad', AIC(fit_quad),'cubic',AIC(fit_cubic),'spline',AIC(fit_spline),'\\n')
cat('adjR2 quad',summary(fit_quad)"'$adj.r.squared,'"'cubic',summary(fit_cubic)"'$adj.r.squared,'"'spline',summary(fit_spline)"'$adj.r.squared,'"'\\n')
cat('BIC quad',BIC(fit_quad),'cubic',BIC(fit_cubic),'spline',BIC(fit_spline),'\\n')
# optimize spline within observed p range
pred <- function(p) predict(fit_spline, newdata=data.frame(p=p))
o <- optimize(function(x) pred(x), interval=range(dd"'$p), maximum=TRUE)
cat('"'spline optimum', o"'$maximum, '"'pred', o"'$objective, '"'\\n')
# find for all
for (f in list(quad=fit_quad, cubic=fit_cubic, spline=fit_spline)) {
  pr <- function(p) predict(f, newdata=data.frame(p=p))
  oo <- optimize(function(x) pr(x), interval=range(dd"'$p), maximum=TRUE)
  cat(oo$maximum, oo$objective, '"'\\n')
}
# maybe optimize domain 0 to 1? spline extrapolation boundary weird but report
for(domain in list(c(0.25,0.999001), c(0,1))) {
 oo <- optimize(function(x) pred(x), interval=domain, maximum=TRUE)
 cat('domain',domain[1],domain[2],'max',oo"'$maximum,oo$objective,'"'\\n')
}
# average replicates then fit same models
agg <- aggregate(Area ~ p, data=dd, FUN=mean)
cat('\\nagg n',nrow(agg),'\\n')
fq <- lm(Area~p+I(p"'^2), data=agg); fc <- lm(Area~p+I(p''^2)+I(p''^3), data=agg); fs <- lm(Area~ns(p,df=4), data=agg)
cat('"'agg AIC',AIC(fq),AIC(fc),AIC(fs),'\\n')
prs <- function(x) predict(fs,newdata=data.frame(p=x))
oo <- optimize(function(x) prs(x), interval=range(agg"'$p), maximum=TRUE)
cat('"'agg spline max',oo"'$maximum,oo$objective,'"'\\n')
RS"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from patsy import dmatrix, cr
import statsmodels.api as sm
try:
    df=pd.read_csv('inputs/Swarm_2.csv')
    dd=df[df.StrainNumber=='287_98'].copy()
    dd['p']=dd.Ratio.str.split(':').apply(lambda z: float(z[0])/sum(map(float,z)))
    y=dd.Area.values; x=dd.p.values

    X=dmatrix('cr(p, df=4)', dd, return_type='dataframe')

    pred=model.predict(Xg)
    i=pred.argmax()

# Compute proportion of strain 287
# For pure strains: 287 -> 1, 98 -> 0
# For mixtures (287_98): parse Ratio like "1:3" -> 1/(1+3)
compute_prop <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == 287) return(1.0)
  if (strain == 98) return(0.0)
  # mixture 287_98
  parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio, ":")[[1]])
  return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
}

  NaturalSpline = mns
)

  if (best_model_name == "Quadratic") {

  }

import base64

r_script = '''#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_file <- args[1]
output_file <- args[2]

library(splines)

dat <- read.csv(input_file)

compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == "287") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98") return(0.0)
  if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / sum(parts))
  }
  return(NA)
}

dat$Proportion <- mapply(compute_proportion, dat$StrainNumber, dat$Ratio)
dat_sub <- subset(dat, !is.na(Proportion))
cat("Data rows after filtering:", nrow(dat_sub), "\\n")
cat("Proportion range:", range(dat_sub$Proportion), "\\n")

m_quad <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2), data = dat_sub)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2) + I(Proportion^3), data = dat_sub)
m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Proportion, df = 4), data = dat_sub)

aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_spline <- AIC(m_spline)

cat("AIC Quadratic:", aic_quad, "\\n")
cat("AIC Cubic:", aic_cubic, "\\n")
cat("AIC Spline:", aic_spline, "\\n")

aics <- c(Quadratic = aic_quad, Cubic = aic_cubic, Spline = aic_spline)
best_model_name <- names(which.min(aics))
cat("Best model:", best_model_name, "\\n")

best_model <- switch(best_model_name,
  Quadratic = m_quad,
  Cubic = m_cubic,
  Spline = m_spline
)

obj_fun <- function(p) {
  newdat <- data.frame(Proportion = p)
  predict(best_model, newdata = newdat)
}

opt <- optimize(obj_fun, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = TRUE)
cat("Optimal proportion:", opt$maximum, "\\n")
cat("Max predicted area:", opt$objective, "\\n")

out <- data.frame(
  BestModel = best_model_name,
  AIC_Quadratic = aic_quad,
  AIC_Cubic = aic_cubic,
  AIC_Spline = aic_spline,
  OptimalProportion = opt$maximum,
  MaxPredictedArea = opt$objective
)

write.csv(out, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Done.\\n")
'''

cat > /workspace/model_fitting.R << 'REOF'
# Read data
data <- read.csv(Sys.getenv("INPUT_CSV"))

# Exclude Strain 1 (unrelated strain)
data <- subset(data, StrainNumber != 1)

# Compute proportion of strain 287 from Ratio and StrainNumber
compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == "287" && ratio == "1:0") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98" && ratio == "1:0") return(0.0)
  # For 287_98 mixtures: ratio "a:b" means a parts 287 to b parts 98
  parts <- strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":")[[1]]
  a <- as.numeric(parts[1])
  b <- as.numeric(parts[2])
  return(a / (a + b))
}

data$Prop287 <- mapply(compute_proportion, data$StrainNumber, data$Ratio)

library(splines)

# Quadratic model
m_quad <- lm(Area ~ Prop287 + I(Prop287^2), data = data)

# Cubic model
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ Prop287 + I(Prop287^2) + I(Prop287^3), data = data)

# Natural spline with df=4
m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Prop287, df = 4), data = data)

# Compare by AIC
aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_spline <- AIC(m_spline)

aics <- c(quadratic = aic_quad, cubic = aic_cubic, spline = aic_spline)
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best_model <- switch(best_name,
  quadratic = m_quad,
  cubic = m_cubic,
  spline = m_spline
)

# Predict over fine grid [0, 1]
grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 10001)
newdata <- data.frame(Prop287 = grid)
pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = newdata)

# Find maximum
max_idx <- which.max(pred)
optimal_freq <- grid[max_idx]
max_area <- pred[max_idx]

# Output results
sink("/output/results.txt")
cat("Best model:", best_name, "\n\n")
cat("AIC values:\n")
for (m in names(aics)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %.4f\n", m, aics[m]))
}
cat("\n")
cat(sprintf("Optimal proportion of strain 287: %.6f\n", optimal_freq))
cat(sprintf("Maximum predicted colony area: %.6f\n", max_area))
sink()
REOF
echo "R script created"

cat("Unique Ratio:", unique(d$Ratio), "\n")

# Compute proportion of strain 287
# For pure strains:
#   StrainNumber 287, Ratio 1:0 -> proportion 287 = 1.0
#   StrainNumber 98, Ratio 1:0  -> proportion 287 = 0.0
#   StrainNumber 1 is a different strain -> exclude
# For mixtures (StrainNumber 287_98):
#   Ratio "X:Y" means 287:98, so proportion 287 = X/(X+Y)

compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == 287 && ratio_str == "1:0") {
    return(1.0)  # pure 287
  } else if (strain == 98 && ratio_str == "1:0") {
    return(0.0)  # pure 98
  } else if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

d$prop287 <- mapply(compute_proportion, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)
cat("\nRows before filtering:", nrow(d), "\n")
d <- d[!is.na(d$prop287), ]
cat("Rows after filtering (287/98 system only):", nrow(d), "\n")

# Show data summary
cat("\nData summary:\n")
print(d[, c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area", "prop287")])

# Fit models
library(splines)

m_quad <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2), data = d)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2) + I(prop287^3), data = d)
m_ns <- lm(Area ~ ns(prop287, df = 4), data = d)

cat("\n===== Model summaries =====\n")
cat("\n--- Quadratic ---\n")
print(summary(m_quad))
cat("\n--- Cubic ---\n")
print(summary(m_cubic))
cat("\n--- Natural spline (df=4) ---\n")
print(summary(m_ns))

# Compare models using AIC and adjusted R²
cat("\n===== Model comparison =====\n")
cat("\nAIC:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", AIC(m_quad), "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", AIC(m_cubic), "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", AIC(m_ns), "\n")

cat("\nAdjusted R-squared:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", summary(m_quad)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", summary(m_cubic)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", summary(m_ns)$adj.r.squared, "\n")

cat("\nResidual standard error:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", summary(m_quad)$sigma, "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", summary(m_cubic)$sigma, "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", summary(m_ns)$sigma, "\n")

# Identify best model by lowest AIC
models <- list(quad = m_quad, cubic = m_cubic, ns = m_ns)
aic_vals <- sapply(models, AIC)
best_name <- names(which.min(aic_vals))
best_model <- models[[best_name]]
cat("\nBest model by AIC:", best_name, "\n")

# Also check by adj R²
adjr2_vals <- sapply(models, function(m) summary(m)$adj.r.squared)
cat("Best model by adj R²:", names(which.max(adjr2_vals)), "\n")

# Find optimum within [0, 1] for the best model
# Grid search on fine grid
grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 10001)
if (best_name == "quad") {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
} else if (best_name == "cubic") {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
} else {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
}

opt_idx <- which.max(pred)
opt_prop <- grid[opt_idx]
opt_area <- pred[opt_idx]

cat("\n===== Optimum for best model (", best_name, ") =====\n", sep="")
cat("Optimal proportion of strain 287:", opt_prop, "\n")
cat("Maximum predicted colony area:", opt_area, "\n")

# Also compute optimum for all models for reference
cat("\n===== Optima for all models =====\n")
for (mname in c("quad", "cubic", "ns")) {
  m <- models[[mname]]
  pred_all <- predict(m, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
  idx <- which.max(pred_all)
  cat(mname, "- optimal prop:", grid[idx], "- max area:", pred_all[idx], "\n")
}

# Plot
png("fit_plot.png", width=800, height=600)
plot(d$prop287, d$Area, pch=19, col=rgb(0,0,0,0.6),

     main="Model fits for colony area vs. proportion of strain 287")
lines(grid, predict(m_quad, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="blue", lwd=2)
lines(grid, predict(m_cubic, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="red", lwd=2, lty=2)
lines(grid, predict(m_ns, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="darkgreen", lwd=2, lty=3)
legend("topleft", legend=c("Quadratic","Cubic","Natural spline (df=4)"),

# Read data
data <- read.csv("inputs/Swarm_2.csv")

# Parse Ratio to get proportion of strain 287
# For mixtures (287_98), ratio is like "1:3" meaning 287:98
# For pure strains, ratio is "1:0"

# Function to extract proportion of strain 287
get_prop_287 <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == "287") {
    return(1.0)  # pure 287
  } else if (strain == "98") {
    return(0.0)  # pure 98
  } else if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
  } else {
    return(NA)  # strain 1, not relevant
  }
}

data$prop_287 <- mapply(get_prop_287, data$StrainNumber, data$Ratio)

# Filter to relevant rows (exclude strain 1)
data_sub <- subset(data, !is.na(prop_287))

cat("Data used:\n")
print(data_sub[, c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "prop_287", "Area")])

# Fit models
# Quadratic
m_quad <- lm(Area ~ prop_287 + I(prop_287^2), data = data_sub)
# Cubic
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ prop_287 + I(prop_287^2) + I(prop_287^3), data = data_sub)
# Natural spline with df=4
library(splines)
m_ns <- lm(Area ~ ns(prop_287, df = 4), data = data_sub)

# Compare models using AIC
aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_ns <- AIC(m_ns)

cat("\nAIC values:\n")
cat(sprintf("Quadratic: %.2f\n", aic_quad))
cat(sprintf("Cubic: %.2f\n", aic_cubic))
cat(sprintf("Natural spline (df=4): %.2f\n", aic_ns))

# Also check adjusted R-squared
adj_r2_quad <- summary(m_quad)$adj.r.squared
adj_r2_cubic <- summary(m_cubic)$adj.r.squared
adj_r2_ns <- summary(m_ns)$adj.r.squared

cat("\nAdjusted R-squared:\n")
cat(sprintf("Quadratic: %.4f\n", adj_r2_quad))
cat(sprintf("Cubic: %.4f\n", adj_r2_cubic))
cat(sprintf("Natural spline (df=4): %.4f\n", adj_r2_ns))

# Determine best model by AIC (lowest)
models <- list(quad = m_quad, cubic = m_cubic, ns = m_ns)
aics <- c(quad = aic_quad, cubic = aic_cubic, ns = aic_ns)
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best_model <- models[[best_name]]

cat(sprintf("\nBest model by AIC: %s\n", best_name))

# Grid search for optimal proportion
grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.0001)
pred_df <- data.frame(prop_287 = grid)
preds <- predict(best_model, newdata = pred_df)

opt_idx <- which.max(preds)
opt_prop <- grid[opt_idx]
max_area <- preds[opt_idx]

cat(sprintf("\nOptimal proportion of strain 287: %.4f\n", opt_prop))
cat(sprintf("Maximum predicted colony area: %.2f\n", max_area))

# Also check with optimize for better precision
pred_func <- function(x) {
  newdata <- data.frame(prop_287 = x)
  predict(best_model, newdata = newdata)
}

opt <- optimize(pred_func, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("\nOptimize result:\n"))
cat(sprintf("Optimal proportion: %.6f\n", opt$maximum))
cat(sprintf("Maximum area: %.2f\n", opt$objective))

# Write answer
dir.create("codex_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(round(opt$objective, 2)), "codex_output/answer.txt")
cat("\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt\n")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run BUSCO-like analysis on four proteomes and find shared single-copy orthologs.

Uses pyhmmer for HMM searches with the eukaryota_odb10 lineage.
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from collections import defaultdict
from multiprocessing import Pool, cpu_count

import pyhmmer

# Paths
BUSCO_ZIP = "/workspace/inputs/busco_downloads.zip"
PROTEOMES = {
    "Cele": "/workspace/inputs/Animals_Cele.faa",
    "Ggal": "/workspace/inputs/Animals_Ggal.faa",
    "Ncra": "/workspace/inputs/Fungi_Ncra.faa",
    "Scer": "/workspace/inputs/Fungi_Scer.faa",
}
HMM_DIR = "/workspace/busco_downloads/lineages/eukaryota_odb10/hmms"
OUTPUT_DIR = "/workspace/busco_results"


def load_scores_cutoff():
    """Parse scores_cutoff from the BUSCO lineage."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(BUSCO_ZIP) as z:
        data = z.read("lineages/eukaryota_odb10/scores_cutoff").decode()
    scores = {}
    for line in data.strip().split("\n"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split("\t")
        scores[parts[0]] = float(parts[1])
    return scores


def load_hmm_profiles():
    """Load all HMM profiles into memory."""
    profiles = {}
    hmm_files = sorted(os.listdir(HMM_DIR))
    for fn in hmm_files:
        if fn.endswith(".hmm"):
            path = os.path.join(HMM_DIR, fn)
            name = fn.replace(".hmm", "")
            with open(path, "rb") as f:
                try:
                    profile = pyhmmer.plan7.HMMFile(f)
                    # Read the HMM
                    hmm = next(profile)
                    profiles[name] = hmm
                except StopIteration:
                    print(f"  WARNING: Empty HMM file: {fn}")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"  WARNING: Failed to load {fn}: {e}")
    return profiles


def search_single_hmm(args):
    """Run hmmsearch for one HMM against one proteome. Returns (busco_id, species, hits)."""
    busco_id, hmm, species, fasta_path = args

    # Read sequences
    sequences = []
    with open(fasta_path, "rb") as f:
        with pyhmmer.easel.SequenceFile(f, format="fasta") as sf:
            seq = sf.read_block()
            while seq is not None:
                for s in seq.sequences:
                    sequences.append(s)
                seq = sf.read_block()

    if not sequences:
        return (busco_id, species, [])

    # Run hmmsearch
    alphabet = pyhmmer.easel.Alphabet.amino()
    pipeline = pyhmmer.plan7.Pipeline(alphabet, Z=len(sequences), domZ=len(sequences))

    hits = []
    with pyhmmer.plan7.HMMPressed(hmm) as pressed:
        for top_hits in pipeline.search_hmm(pressed, sequences):
            for hit in top_hits:
                # hit is a TopHits object - we need to get the best domain score
                for dom in hit.domains.included:
                    hits.append({
                        "seq_name": hit.name.decode() if isinstance(hit.name, bytes) else hit.name,
                        "score": dom.score,
                        "bias": dom.bias,
                    })

    return (busco_id, species, hits)


def run_busco_analysis(profiles, scores_cutoff, n_workers=4):
    """Run BUSCO analysis on all four proteomes."""
    # Build task list
    tasks = []
    for busco_id, hmm in sorted(profiles.items()):
        for species, fasta_path in PROTEOMES.items():
            tasks.append((busco_id, hmm, species, fasta_path))

    print(f"Running {len(tasks)} HMM searches with {n_workers} workers...")

    # Run searches in parallel
    results = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
    completed = 0

    with Pool(n_workers) as pool:
        for busco_id, species, hits in pool.imap_unordered(search_single_hmm, tasks):
            results[species][busco_id] = hits
            completed += 1
            if completed % 100 == 0:
                print(f"  {completed}/{len(tasks)} searches completed...")

    print(f"All {completed} searches completed.")
    return results


def classify_buscos(results, scores_cutoff):
    """Classify each BUSCO in each proteome as Complete (single/multi), Fragmented, or Missing."""
    classification = defaultdict(dict)

    for species in PROTEOMES.keys():
        for busco_id in results[species]:
            hits = results[species][busco_id]
            threshold = scores_cutoff.get(busco_id, 0)

            # Count hits that meet the score threshold
            complete_hits = [h for h in hits if h["score"] >= threshold]

            if len(complete_hits) == 0:
                # Check if there are any hits at all (fragmented)
                if len(hits) > 0:
                    classification[species][busco_id] = "Fragmented"
                else:
                    classification[species][busco_id] = "Missing"
            elif len(complete_hits) == 1:
                classification[species][busco_id] = "Complete_Single"
            else:
                classification[species][busco_id] = "Complete_Duplicated"

    return classification


def main():
    print("=== BUSCO Analysis: Single-copy Orthologs Across Four Proteomes ===\n")

    # Load scores cutoff

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run BUSCO-like analysis on four proteomes and find shared single-copy orthologs.

Uses pyhmmer for HMM searches with the eukaryota_odb10 lineage.
In BUSCO protein mode:
- Each HMM profile is searched against the proteome
- Hits with bit score >= scores_cutoff[busco_id] are "Complete"
- "Single-copy complete" = exactly 1 hit with bit score >= threshold
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from collections import defaultdict

import pyhmmer


# Paths
BUSCO_ZIP = "/workspace/inputs/busco_downloads.zip"
PROTEOMES = {
    "Cele": "/workspace/inputs/Animals_Cele.faa",
    "Ggal": "/workspace/inputs/Animals_Ggal.faa",
    "Ncra": "/workspace/inputs/Fungi_Ncra.faa",
    "Scer": "/workspace/inputs/Fungi_Scer.faa",
}
HMM_DIR = "/workspace/busco_downloads/lineages/eukaryota_odb10/hmms"


def load_scores_cutoff():
    """Parse scores_cutoff from the BUSCO lineage."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(BUSCO_ZIP) as z:
        data = z.read("lineages/eukaryota_odb10/scores_cutoff").decode()
    scores = {}
    for line in data.strip().split("\n"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split("\t")
        scores[parts[0]] = float(parts[1])
    return scores


def load_sequences(fasta_path):
    """Load all sequences from a FASTA file into a DigitalSequenceBlock."""
    alphabet = pyhmmer.easel.Alphabet.amino()
    seq_block = pyhmmer.easel.DigitalSequenceBlock(alphabet)
    with open(fasta_path, "rb") as f:
        with pyhmmer.easel.SequenceFile(f, format="fasta") as sf:
            for seq in sf:
                seq_block.append(seq.digitize(alphabet))
    return seq_block


def run_hmm_search(hmm, seq_block):
    """Run hmmsearch for one HMM against a sequence block.
    Returns list of (name, best_domain_score) for included hits.
    """
    alphabet = pyhmmer.easel.Alphabet.amino()
    pipeline = pyhmmer.plan7.Pipeline(
        alphabet,
        Z=len(seq_block),
        domZ=len(seq_block),
        bit_cutoffs=None,
        incE=100.0,
        incdomE=100.0,
    )

    hits = []
    top_hits = pipeline.search_hmm(hmm, seq_block)
    for hit in top_hits:
        if hit.included:
            best_score = max(d.score for d in hit.domains)
            hits.append((hit.name, best_score))
    return hits


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    print("=== BUSCO Analysis: Single-copy Orthologs Across Four Proteomes ===")
    print(f"Lineage: eukaryota_odb10, Mode: proteins\n")

    # Load scores cutoff
    print("Loading scores_cutoff...")
    scores_cutoff = load_scores_cutoff()
    print(f"  Loaded {len(scores_cutoff)} score thresholds")

    # Pre-load all proteomes
    print("\nLoading proteomes into memory...")
    proteome_seqs = {}
    for name, path in PROTEOMES.items():
        print(f"  Loading {name} ({os.path.basename(path)})...")
        proteome_seqs[name] = load_sequences(path)
        print(f"    {len(proteome_seqs[name])} sequences loaded")

    # Load all HMM profiles
    print("\nLoading HMM profiles...")
    hmm_files = sorted([f for f in os.listdir(HMM_DIR) if f.endswith(".hmm")])
    hmm_profiles = {}
    for fn in hmm_files:
        busco_id = fn.replace(".hmm", "")
        path = os.path.join(HMM_DIR, fn)
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            try:
                hmm_file = pyhmmer.plan7.HMMFile(f)
                hmm_profiles[busco_id] = next(hmm_file)
            except StopIteration:
                print(f"  WARNING: Empty HMM: {fn}")

    print(f"  Loaded {len(hmm_profiles)} HMM profiles")

    # Run all searches
    n_total = len(hmm_profiles) * len(PROTEOMES)
    print(f"\nRunning {n_total} HMM searches...")

    # Store results: {species: {busco_id: [(seq_name, score), ...]}}
    results = {sp: {} for sp in PROTEOMES}
    completed = 0

    for busco_id in sorted(hmm_profiles.keys()):
        hmm = hmm_profiles[busco_id]
        for species in PROTEOMES:
            hits = run_hmm_search(hmm, proteome_seqs[species])
            results[species][busco_id] = hits
            completed += 1
            if completed % 100 == 0 or completed == n_total:
                elapsed = time.time() - t0
                rate = completed / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0
                eta = (n_total - completed) / rate if rate > 0 else 0
                print(f"  [{completed}/{n_total}] {rate:.1f}/s ETA: {eta:.0f}s")

    # Classify BUSCOs
    print("\nClassifying BUSCO status per species...")
    classification = {sp: {} for sp in PROTEOMES}

    for species in PROTEOMES:
        for busco_id, hits in results[species].items():
            threshold = scores_cutoff.get(busco_id, 0)
            complete_hits = [(name, score) for name, score in hits if score >= threshold]

            if len(complete_hits) == 0:
                if len(hits) > 0:
                    classification[species][busco_id] = "Fragmented"
                else:
                    classification[species][busco_id] = "Missing"
            elif len(complete_hits) == 1:
                classification[species][busco_id] = "Complete_Single"
            else:
                classification[species][busco_id] = "Complete_Duplicated"

    # Per-species summary
    print("\n=== Per-Species BUSCO Results ===\n")
    for species in ["Cele", "Ggal", "Ncra", "Scer"]:
        c = classification[species]
        complete_single = sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == "Complete_Single")
        complete_dup = sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == "Complete_Duplicated")
        fragmented = sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == "Fragmented")
        missing = sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == "Missing")
        total = len(c)
        complete = complete_single + complete_dup
        print(f"  {species}: C:{complete} [S:{complete_single}, D:{complete_dup}], "
              f"F:{fragmented}, M:{missing}, n:{total}")

    # Find shared single-copy complete BUSCOs
    all_buscos = sorted(hmm_profiles.keys())
    shared = []
    for busco_id in all_buscos:
        if all(classification[sp].get(busco_id) == "Complete_Single" for sp in PROTEOMES):
            shared.append(busco_id)

    print(f"\n=== Shared Single-Copy Complete Orthologs ===")
    print(f"Count: {len(shared)}")

    # Write answer
    os.makedirs("/workspace/codex_output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(str(len(shared)) + "\n")
    print(f"Answer written to /workspace/codex_output/answer.txt")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"\nTotal time: {elapsed:.1f}s")
    return shared


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run BUSCO-like analysis on four proteomes using eukaryota_odb10 HMM profiles.

Uses pyhmmer for HMM searches. For each proteome, runs all 255 HMM profiles
and classifies BUSCOs as Complete (single/duplicated), Fragmented, or Missing
based on the scores_cutoff thresholds.

Outputs the count of BUSCOs that are Complete and Single-copy in ALL four proteomes.
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from collections import defaultdict

import pyhmmer


BUSCO_ZIP = "/workspace/inputs/busco_downloads.zip"
HMM_FILE = "/workspace/eukaryota_odb10_all.hmm"

PROTEOMES = [
    ("Cele", "/workspace/inputs/Animals_Cele.faa"),
    ("Ggal", "/workspace/inputs/Animals_Ggal.faa"),
    ("Ncra", "/workspace/inputs/Fungi_Ncra.faa"),
    ("Scer", "/workspace/inputs/Fungi_Scer.faa"),
]


def load_scores_cutoff():
    """Parse scores_cutoff from the BUSCO lineage zip."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(BUSCO_ZIP) as z:
        data = z.read("lineages/eukaryota_odb10/scores_cutoff").decode()
    scores = {}
    for line in data.strip().split("\n"):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split("\t")
        scores[parts[0]] = float(parts[1])
    return scores


def load_sequences(fasta_path):
    """Load sequences from a FASTA file into a DigitalSequenceBlock."""
    alphabet = pyhmmer.easel.Alphabet.amino()
    seq_block = pyhmmer.easel.DigitalSequenceBlock(alphabet)
    with open(fasta_path, "rb") as f:
        with pyhmmer.easel.SequenceFile(f, format="fasta") as sf:
            for seq in sf:
                seq_block.append(seq.digitize(alphabet))
    return seq_block


def run_all_searches(seq_block, hmm_file_path):
    """Run hmmsearch for all HMMs in the file against a sequence block.
    Returns dict: {busco_id: [(seq_name, best_domain_score), ...]}
    """
    alphabet = pyhmmer.easel.Alphabet.amino()
    pipeline = pyhmmer.plan7.Pipeline(
        alphabet,
        Z=len(seq_block),
        domZ=len(seq_block),
        bit_cutoffs=None,
        incE=100.0,
        incdomE=100.0,
    )

    results = {}
    with open(hmm_file_path, "rb") as f:
        hmm_file = pyhmmer.plan7.HMMFile(f)
        for hmm in hmm_file:
            busco_id = hmm.name.decode() if isinstance(hmm.name, bytes) else hmm.name
            top_hits = pipeline.search_hmm(hmm, seq_block)
            hits = []
            for hit in top_hits:
                if hit.included:
                    best_score = max(d.score for d in hit.domains)
                    hits.append((hit.name, best_score))
            results[busco_id] = hits
    return results


def classify(results, scores_cutoff):
    """Classify BUSCOs per species into Complete_Single, Complete_Duplicated,
    Fragmented, or Missing."""
    classification = {}
    for busco_id, hits in results.items():
        threshold = scores_cutoff.get(busco_id, 0)
        complete = [(n, s) for n, s in hits if s >= threshold]

        if len(complete) == 0:
            if len(hits) > 0:
                classification[busco_id] = "Fragmented"
            else:
                classification[busco_id] = "Missing"
        elif len(complete) == 1:
            classification[busco_id] = "Complete_Single"
        else:
            classification[busco_id] = "Complete_Duplicated"
    return classification


def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    print("=== BUSCO Analysis: Single-copy Orthologs Across Four Proteomes ===")
    print("Lineage: eukaryota_odb10 | Mode: proteins | BUSCO count: 255\n")

    # Load scores cutoff
    print("[1/3] Loading scores_cutoff...")
    scores_cutoff = load_scores_cutoff()
    print(f"      Loaded {len(scores_cutoff)} thresholds")

    # Run searches for each proteome
    print("\n[2/3] Running HMM searches against each proteome...")
    all_results = {}
    all_classifications = {}

    for sp_name, sp_path in PROTEOMES:
        sp_t0 = time.time()
        print(f"\n  --- {sp_name} ({os.path.basename(sp_path)}) ---")

        print(f"  Loading sequences...")
        seq_block = load_sequences(sp_path)
        n_seqs = len(seq_block)
        print(f"  {n_seqs} sequences loaded")

        print(f"  Running {255} HMM searches...")
        results = run_all_searches(seq_block, HMM_FILE)
        print(f"  {len(results)} BUSCOs searched")

        # Classify
        classif = classify(results, scores_cutoff)
        all_classifications[sp_name] = classif
        all_results[sp_name] = results

        # Summary
        cs = sum(1 for v in classif.values() if v == "Complete_Single")
        cd = sum(1 for v in classif.values() if v == "Complete_Duplicated")
        fg = sum(1 for v in classif.values() if v == "Fragmented")
        ms = sum(1 for v in classif.values() if v == "Missing")
        print(f"  C:{cs+cd} [S:{cs}, D:{cd}], F:{fg}, M:{ms}, n:{len(classif)}")
        print(f"  Time: {time.time() - sp_t0:.1f}s")

    # Find shared single-copy complete BUSCOs
    print("\n[3/3] Finding orthologs complete and single-copy in all four...")
    all_busco_ids = sorted(scores_cutoff.keys())
    shared = []

    for busco_id in all_busco_ids:
        if all(
            all_classifications[sp].get(busco_id) == "Complete_Single"
            for sp, _ in PROTEOMES
        ):
            shared.append(busco_id)

    print(f"\n  Shared single-copy complete orthologs: {len(shared)}")

    # Show per-species table
    print("\n=== Final Summary ===")
    header = f"{'Species':<8} {'Complete':>10} {'Single':>8} {'Duplicated':>12} {'Fragmented':>12} {'Missing':>10}"
    print(header)
    print("-" * len(header))
    for sp_name, _ in PROTEOMES:
        c = all_classifications[sp_name]
        cs = sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == "Complete_Single")
        cd = sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == "Complete_Duplicated")
        fg = sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == "Fragmented")
        ms = sum(1 for v in c.values() if v == "Missing")
        print(f"{sp_name:<8} {cs+cd:>10} {cs:>8} {cd:>12} {fg:>12} {ms:>10}")

    # Write answer
    os.makedirs("/workspace/codex_output", exist_ok=True)
    with open("/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(f"{len(shared)}\n")
    print(f"\nAnswer: {len(shared)}")
    print(f"Written to /workspace/codex_output/answer.txt")
    print(f"Total time: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s")

    return shared


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# More detailed analysis
import gzip

vcf_path = "/workspace/inputs/SRR35233585_raw_variants.vcf"
f = open(vcf_path, 'r')

ts_sites = 0
tv_sites = 0
ts_alleles = 0
tv_alleles = 0
indel_count = 0
mnp_count = 0
other_count = 0
het_count = 0
hom_alt_count = 0
hom_ref_count = 0

transitions = {
    ('A', 'G'), ('G', 'A'),
    ('C', 'T'), ('T', 'C')
}

for line in f:
    if line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    fields = line.strip().split('\t')
    if len(fields) < 10:
        continue
    
    ref = fields[3]
    alt_field = fields[4]
    
    # Parse genotype
    fmt = fields[8].split(':')
    gt_idx = fmt.index('GT')
    gt = fields[9].split(':')[gt_idx]
    
    if gt == '0/1' or gt == '1/0' or gt == '0|1' or gt == '1|0':
        het_count += 1
    elif gt == '1/1' or gt == '1|1':
        hom_alt_count += 1
    elif gt == '0/0' or gt == '0|0':
        hom_ref_count += 1
    
    # Check if SNV
    if len(ref) != 1:
        if len(ref) > 1:
            mnp_count += 1 if ',' not in alt_field else 0
        else:
            other_count += 1
        continue
    
    alts = alt_field.split(',')
    all_snv = all(len(a) == 1 for a in alts)
    
    if not all_snv:
        # Contains indels or mixed
        indel_count += len([a for a in alts if len(a) != 1])
        # Still count SNV alleles
        snv_alts = [a for a in alts if len(a) == 1]
        for a in snv_alts:
            ts_alleles += 1 if (ref, a) in transitions else 0
            tv_alleles += 0 if (ref, a) in transitions else 1
        continue
    
    # All alleles are SNVs
    # Site-level: check if ANY allele is transition or transversion
    # For site-level, if multiallelic we count the site once
    site_is_ts = any((ref, a) in transitions for a in alts)
    site_is_tv = any((ref, a) not in transitions for a in alts)
    
    if site_is_ts and not site_is_tv:
        ts_sites += 1
    elif site_is_tv and not site_is_ts:
        tv_sites += 1
    else:
        # Mixed multiallelic site
        ts_sites += 1  # count as both? Most tools would count as separate
        tv_sites += 1
    
    # Allele-level counting
    for a in alts:
        if (ref, a) in transitions:
            ts_alleles += 1
        else:
            tv_alleles += 1

f.close()

total_snv_sites = ts_sites + tv_sites
total_snv_alleles = ts_alleles + tv_alleles

print(f"--- Variant type counts ---")
print(f"Homozygous alt (1/1): {hom_alt_count}")
print(f"Heterozygous (0/1): {het_count}")
print(f"Homozygous ref (0/0): {hom_ref_count}")
print(f"Indels/MNPs/other: {indel_count + mnp_count + other_count}")
print()
print(f"--- Allele-level Ts/Tv ---")
print(f"Ts alleles: {ts_alleles}")
print(f"Tv alleles: {tv_alleles}")
print(f"Total SNV alleles: {total_snv_alleles}")
print(f"Ts/Tv (allele-level): {ts_alleles/tv_alleles:.4f} -> {ts_alleles/tv_alleles:.2f}")
print()
print(f"--- Site-level Ts/Tv ---")
print(f"Ts sites: {ts_sites}")
print(f"Tv sites: {tv_sites}")
print(f"Total SNV sites: {total_snv_sites}")
print(f"Ts/Tv (site-level): {ts_sites/tv_sites:.4f} -> {ts_sites/tv_sites:.2f}")

vcf_path = "/workspace/inputs/SRR35233585_raw_variants.vcf"
f = open(vcf_path, 'r')

transitions = {('A','G'), ('G','A'), ('C','T'), ('T','C')}
VALID_BASES = set('ACGT')

# All alleles
ts_all = 0
tv_all = 0
# First ALT only
ts_first = 0
tv_first = 0
# Site-level (multiallelic counts as one site)
ts_site = 0
tv_site = 0

star_allele_count = 0
mixed_indel_snv = 0

for line in f:
    if line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    fields = line.strip().split('\t')
    if len(fields) < 5:
        continue
    ref = fields[3]
    alt_field = fields[4]
    
    # Only count sites where REF is a single valid base
    if len(ref) != 1 or ref not in VALID_BASES:
        continue
    
    alts = alt_field.split(',')
    
    # Filter to valid SNV alleles (single valid base, not *)
    snv_alts = [a for a in alts if len(a) == 1 and a in VALID_BASES]
    
    if not snv_alts:
        continue
    
    # All-allele counting
    for a in snv_alts:
        if (ref, a) in transitions:
            ts_all += 1
        else:
            tv_all += 1
    
    # First ALT only
    if snv_alts[0] == alts[0]:  # first valid SNV is the first ALT
        if (ref, snv_alts[0]) in transitions:
            ts_first += 1
        else:
            tv_first += 1
    # (if first alt was *, skip this record for first-ALT counting)
    
    # Site-level: if any ALT is Ts, count as Ts; else Tv
    # (for pure SNV sites only)
    is_ts = any((ref, a) in transitions for a in snv_alts)
    is_tv = any((ref, a) not in transitions for a in snv_alts)
    if is_ts and is_tv:
        # Mixed multiallelic - unusual, count both
        ts_site += 1
        tv_site += 1
    elif is_ts:
        ts_site += 1
    elif is_tv:
        tv_site += 1

f.close()

Start from a defensible baseline, change parameters only for a stated

read_ee <- function(file, trunc) {
  con <- gzfile(file, 'rt'); on.exit(close(con))
  ees <- numeric(); lens <- integer(); n <- 0L
  repeat {
    h <- readLines(con, n=1)
    if (length(h) == 0) break
    seq <- readLines(con, n=1); plus <- readLines(con, n=1); qual <- readLines(con, n=1)
    n <- n + 1L
    if (n > 5000) break
    qchars <- strsplit(substr(qual, 1, min(trunc, nchar(qual))), '', fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
    qs <- utf8ToInt(paste0(qchars, collapse='')) - 33L
    ees[n] <- sum(10"'^(-qs/10))
    lens[n] <- nchar(seq)
  }
  quantile(ees, probs=c(.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95,.99), na.rm=TRUE)
}

  }))

}

#"'!/usr/bin/env python3
import h5py
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import sparse
from pathlib import Path

adata_path = Path('"'/workspace/data/inputs/source_anndata_file/Source%20AnnData%20file.h5ad')
out_meta = Path('/workspace/pseudobulk_metadata.tsv')
out_all = Path('/workspace/pseudobulk_counts_raw_all.tsv')

with h5py.File(adata_path, 'r') as f:
    # observations
    obs = {}
    for key in ['individual', 'cell_type', 'disease', 'sex']:
        g = f['obs'][key]
        cats = [x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else x for x in g['categories'][:]]
        codes = g['codes'][:]
        obs[key] = np.array([cats[c] for c in codes], dtype=object)
    obs['barcode'] = np.array([
        x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else x for x in f['obs']['_index'][:]
    ], dtype=object)
    # variables
    var_symbol = np.array([
        x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else x for x in f['var']['gene_symbol'][:]
    ], dtype=object)
    var_ensembl = np.array([
        x.decode() if isinstance(x, bytes) else x for x in f['var']['ensembl_gene_id'][:]
    ], dtype=object)
    # counts layer CSR
    g = f['layers/counts']
    data = np.asarray(g['data'][:])
    indices = np.asarray(g['indices'][:])
    indptr = np.asarray(g['indptr'][:])
    shape = tuple(g.attrs['shape'])
    X = sparse.csr_matrix((data, indices, indptr), shape=shape)

obs_df = pd.DataFrame(obs)
obs_df['individual_cell'] = obs_df['individual'] + '||' + obs_df['cell_type']
# cell counts before >=10 filtering
keep_counts = obs_df.groupby('individual_cell').size()

# Create dummy matrix for retained individual-cell combinations only.
groups = obs_df['individual_cell'].values
valid = obs_df['individual_cell'].isin(keep_counts[keep_counts >= 10].index).values
obs_df = obs_df.loc[valid].copy()
groups_kept = pd.Categorical(obs_df['individual_cell'])
indicator = sparse.csr_matrix(
    (np.ones(obs_df.shape[0], dtype=np.float64),
     (np.arange(obs_df.shape[0], dtype=np.int32), groups_kept.codes.astype(np.int32))),
    shape=(obs_df.shape[0], len(groups_kept.categories))
)
Xk = X[valid, :]
pseudo = (indicator.T @ Xk).tocsr()
pseudo = np.asarray(pseudo.todense(), dtype=np.float64)
pseudo = np.rint(pseudo).astype(np.int64)
# sample metadata: unique retained groups, order matches categories
sample_meta = obs_df.groupby('individual_cell').agg(
    individual=('individual', 'first'),
    cell_type=('cell_type', 'first'),
    disease=('disease', 'first'),
    n_cells=('barcode', 'size'),
).reindex(groups_kept.categories).reset_index(drop=True)
sample_meta['sample'] = sample_meta['individual'] + '_' + sample_meta['cell_type']
sample_meta['sample'] = sample_meta['sample'].str.replace(' ', '_', regex=False).str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
sample_meta['total_counts'] = pseudo.sum(axis=1)

# Dump all filtered-sample pseudobulk before gene filtering for trace/audit.
sample_meta.to_csv(out_meta, sep='\\t', index=False)
gene_ids = np.array([f'{s}_{e}' for s,e in zip(var_symbol, var_ensembl)], dtype=object)
all_df = pd.DataFrame(pseudo, columns=sample_meta['sample'].values, index=gene_ids)
all_df.to_csv(out_all, sep='\\t', index=True, index_label='gene')
print('cells:', X.shape[0], 'genes:', X.shape[1])
print('retained sample groups:', sample_meta.shape[0])
print(sample_meta.to_string(index=False))
print('total counts summary:')
print(sample_meta['total_counts'].describe().to_string())
print('wrote', out_meta, out_all)
PY

#"'!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import math
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

warnings.filterwarnings('"'ignore')

ROOT = Path('/workspace')
RAW = ROOT / 'pseudobulk_counts_raw_all.tsv'
META = ROOT / 'pseudobulk_metadata.tsv'
OUT_DIR = ROOT / 'final_answer'
OUT_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

meta = pd.read_csv(META, sep='\\t')
raw = pd.read_csv(RAW, sep='\\t', index_col=0)
samples = meta['sample'].astype(str).tolist()
N = len(samples)
M = float(np.median(meta['total_counts']))
S = int(math.ceil(10 + 0.7 * (N - 10)))
cpm_threshold = 10.0 / M * 1_000_000.0

counts_gene_x_sample = raw[samples].astype(float)
totals = meta['total_counts'].astype(float).values
cpm = counts_gene_x_sample.values / totals[None, :] * 1_000_000.0
n_samples_over_threshold = (cpm >= cpm_threshold).sum(axis=1)
summed_counts = counts_gene_x_sample.values.sum(axis=1)
keep = (n_samples_over_threshold >= S) & (summed_counts >= 1000)

# "'`gene_symbol` values from the all-gene index (<symbol>_ENSG...).
gene_symbols = pd.Series([x.split('"'_ENSG')[0] for x in raw.index], index=raw.index)
filtered_gene_x_sample = counts_gene_x_sample.loc[keep].copy()
filtered_gene_x_sample.index = gene_symbols.loc[filtered_gene_x_sample.index].values
filtered_gene_x_sample.index.name = 'gene'
filtered_gene_x_sample.columns = samples
filtered_gene_x_sample = filtered_gene_x_sample.astype(int)

# Write required pseudobulk matrix.
filtered_gene_x_sample.to_csv(OUT_DIR / 'pseudobulk_counts.tsv', sep='\\t', index=True)

# Build sample metadata for DESeq2. Categorical order makes COVID-19 the
# reference level, so disease[T.normal] is the normal-minus-COVID-19 effect.
sample_meta = meta.set_index('sample').loc[samples].copy()
sample_meta['disease'] = pd.Categorical(sample_meta['disease'], categories=['COVID-19', 'normal'])
sample_meta['cell_type'] = pd.Categorical(sample_meta['cell_type'])

# PyDESeq2 expects samples x genes.
counts_sample_x_gene = filtered_gene_x_sample.T.copy()
counts_sample_x_gene.index.name = 'sample'
counts_sample_x_gene = counts_sample_x_gene.astype(int)

dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_sample_x_gene,
    metadata=sample_meta,
    design='~ disease + cell_type',
    quiet=False,
    n_cpus=1,
)
dds.deseq2()

stat = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=['disease', 'normal', 'COVID-19'],
    cooks_filter=False,
    independent_filter=False,
    n_cpus=1,
)
stat.summary()
res = stat.results_df.copy()
res.index.name = 'gene'

# Ensure one row per filtered gene and no NA/outlier omissions.
if not res.index.equals(filtered_gene_x_sample.index):
    res = res.reindex(filtered_gene_x_sample.index)

lfc = pd.to_numeric(res['log2FoldChange'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
pval = pd.to_numeric(res['pvalue'], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Keep finite log2 fold changes. Where a value is missing/non-finite from
# the estimator, use 0 as a finite neutral value.
lfc = np.where(np.isfinite(lfc), lfc, 0.0)
# Keep p-values valid. Where missing/non-finite, use 1 before BH adjustment.
pval = np.where(np.isfinite(pval) & (pval >= 0) & (pval <= 1), pval, 1.0)

# Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment over all genes in this table.
rank = np.argsort(np.argsort(pval)) + 1
fdr = pval * len(pval) / rank
# BH is monotone in sorted order; enforce monotonicity by cumulative max in sorted order.
order = np.argsort(pval)
fdr_sorted = np.minimum(1, pval[order] * len(pval) / np.arange(1, len(pval) + 1))
fdr_sorted = np.maximum.accumulate(fdr_sorted)
fdr_final = np.empty_like(fdr_sorted)
fdr_final[order] = fdr_sorted

out = pd.DataFrame({
    'gene': filtered_gene_x_sample.index.values,
    'log2_fold_change': lfc,
    'p_value': pval,
    'fdr': fdr_final,
})
out.to_csv(OUT_DIR / 'differential_expression.tsv', sep='\\t', index=False)

(OUT_DIR / 'method.json').write_text(json.dumps({'method': 'DESeq2'}) + '\\n')

print('N', N, 'M', M, 'S', S, 'cpm_threshold', cpm_threshold, 'genes_retained', len(out), flush=True)
print('p_value range', pval.min(), pval.max(), 'fdr range', out['fdr'].min(), out['fdr'].max(), flush=True)
print('log2FC nonfinite original', int((~np.isfinite(pd.to_numeric(res['log2FoldChange'], errors='coerce').astype(float))).sum()), flush=True)
print('pvalue NA/invalid original', int((~np.isfinite(pd.to_numeric(res['pvalue'], errors='coerce').astype(float)) | (pd.to_numeric(res['pvalue'], errors='coerce').astype(float) < 0) | (pd.to_numeric(res['pvalue'], errors='coerce').astype(float) > 1)).sum()), flush=True)
print('done', flush=True)
